title: Working Student - Product Management in Payment Card Solutions (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Marketing and Product Management: Support operational marketing and product management, and coordinate and support ongoing activities
  • Marketing Communications: Maintain marketing communications and update and provide marketing materials
  • Market and Business Analysis: Create, update, and further develop market models and business cases, and analyze and summarize market studies and trends
  • Competitive Analysis: Monitor the competitive landscape and present findings in a structured manner
  • Go-to-Market: Support the implementation of go-to-market activities
  • AI Agents and Process Optimization: Create AI agents to optimize workflows, competitive analyses, and marketing content

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Field of Study: Currently studying Business Administration, Industrial Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or a comparable field
  • Skills: Very good knowledge of M365, experience with Copilot and AI agents, and advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills; ability to structure analyses and present results clearly
  • Working Style: Independent and solution-oriented approach to work, with a creative approach to new or challenging tasks
  • Personality: Strong analytical thinking skills
  • Interests: Enjoy working in a diverse and international environment
  • Experience: Ideally, some initial knowledge of or experience in the payments market and/or consumer electronics
  • Language Skills: Very good English skills; German skills are a plus

Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

Important information:

  • Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
  • Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
  • You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

Further links:

  • Find out what we are looking for in your CV
  • Find out how the student application process works with us
  • Discover our student website



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Britta Johansson

title: Working Student - Product Marketing Communications (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Content Management: You create, maintain, and update product, promotional, and internal web content across external websites, myInfineon, and iShare 
  • Website Optimization: You review product and overview pages, perform regular quality checks, verify data accuracy, and optimize content for search engines in collaboration with the Web Coordinator 
  • Web Analytics: You analyze website performance and visitor behavior using analytics tools and derive recommendations to improve content effectiveness 
  • Product Marketing Support: You support product launches, coordinate with internal stakeholders, update product presentations, and assist in the creation of marketing collateral 



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Academic Background: You are currently pursuing a degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Marketing and Communications, Artificial Intelligence, or a related field 
  • Analytical Skills: You demonstrate a strong analytical mindset and enjoy working with data, insights, and performance metrics 
  • AI Competence: You have hands-on experience with prompt engineering, AI-assisted research, AI-supported coding, and workflow automation 
  • Innovation Mindset: You identify opportunities to implement AI-driven solutions and improve existing processes 
  • Tools & Technologies: You are proficient in Excel and Tableau and have practical experience with tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, Microsoft Copilot, or similar AI solutions 
  • Communication Skills: You communicate effectively with diverse stakeholders and enjoy working in a collaborative environment
  • Language Skills: You speak fluently German and English

 

 

Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

  


Important information:

  • Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
  • Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
  • You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

 


Further links:

  • Find out what we are looking for in your CV
  • Find out how the student application process works with us
  • Discover our student website





#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Kerstin Semmler

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Take responsibility: Develop and maintain digital solutions to automate and optimize business processes
  • Data is everything: Build data and reporting solutions using Python, SQL, Tableau, FastAPI, and React
  • Focus on the future: Integrate, test, and continuously improve applications, ensuring reliability, performance, and usability
  • Identify needs: Translate business requirements into technical solutions and support documentation and knowledge transfer

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study field: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Business Informatics, Information Systems, or a comparable technical field
  • Programming skills: Strong knowledge of Python and SQL, with experience in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern web-development frameworks such as FastAPI and React
  • Way of working: Independent and solution-oriented approach to work, with a creative approach to new or challenging tasks
  • Language skills: Fluency in English

title: Working Student - Electronic Measurements at cryogenic temperatures for Trapped Ion Quantum Computer (f/m/div)
standardized_locations: Munich, BY, DE, Munich, BY, DE
description_html:

Are you in?



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Take Responsibility: Support the preparation and handling of electronic and semiconductor samples for characterization at cryogenic temperatures, including soldering and wire-bonding
  • Focus on the Future: Oversee cryogenic measurements down to -268°C, ensuring the correct setup, operation, and functionality of cryostats and measurement equipment
  • Keep Track of Everything: Evaluate experimental data, analyze measurement results, and summarize findings in a clear and structured manner
  • Teamwork Is Dreamwork: Collaborate closely with engineers, provide feedback on experimental procedures, suggest improvements, and contribute to an innovative team environment
  • Keep Your Colleagues Informed: Maintain detailed documentation of experiments, procedures, and results to support internal knowledge sharing and external reporting


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study Field: Currently enrolled in Physics, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field
  • Work Style: You work systematically and methodically, demonstrate strong attention to detail, and maintain a high level of accuracy when handling delicate equipment and samples
  • Personality: Eager to learn, adaptable to new tools and laboratory protocols, and enjoy working in a collaborative team environment
  • Skills: Experience working in laboratory environments and possess basic soldering skills; knowledge of wire-bonding, Python, MATLAB, or PCB design is considered a plus
  • Language Skills: Very good written and spoken English skills; German language skills are an advantage

  • Drive collaboration: Contribute to the planning and execution of tradeshows, conferences, training events, and workshops, ensuring seamless coordination among internal stakeholders

title: Working Student - Project Management & Software Ecosystem (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Holistic Overview: You maintain and continuously improve the department’s overview of ongoing projects, milestones and dependencies, ensuring transparency across teams and serving as the main point of contact for project status updates
  • Take Responsibility: You drive actions, decisions and risks to closure by proactively following up with stakeholders, identifying blockers early and escalating challenges together with solution proposals
  • Experience Project Management: You organize and facilitate recurring meetings, planning sessions and workshops, prepare agendas, document outcomes and ensure agreed actions are tracked and completed
  • Thorough Planning: You support quarterly planning and review cycles by consolidating project plans and status updates, identifying gaps, conflicting priorities and timeline risks, and presenting recommendations to management
  • Strength in Numbers: You analyze project progress, workload and performance data, build dashboards and reports using tools such as Excel, Power BI or Python, and derive insights to support data-driven decision-making

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study Field: You are currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related technical field
  • (Work) Experience: You have gained initial experience in project coordination, team organization or agile environments through internships, student projects, robotics teams, student associations or similar activities
  • Interests: You have a strong interest in software development and embedded systems and possess a basic understanding of software engineering processes, version control, testing and microcontroller-based systems
  • Work Style: You work in a structured and proactive manner, take ownership of your responsibilities, manage multiple topics simultaneously and communicate confidently with engineers, stakeholders and management
  • Skills: You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Teams and Outlook, and ideally have experience with Jira, Confluence, GitHub, Power BI or Python
  • Language Skills: You have very good written and spoken English skills and feel comfortable collaborating in an international and cross-functional environment


Please attach the following documents to your application:

·       CV in English

·       Certificate of enrollment at university

·       Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

·       High school report

  

Important information:

·       Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week.

·       Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

·       You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

title: Working Student - Quality Assurance & Software Testing (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Take responsibility: You systematically test software features, user journeys and edge cases to ensure a high level of product quality
  • Thorough Planning: You create structured and reproducible test cases, define acceptance criteria and document test results in a clear and consistent way
  • Keep track of everything: You identify missing functionality, defects, inconsistencies and usability issues and document them in Jira with detailed reproduction steps, expected and actual behavior, and relevant evidence
  • Collaboration: You collaborate closely with developers and product stakeholders to discuss findings, clarify requirements and support quality improvements, viewing QA as a collaborative process for improving product quality rather than a simple pass/fail gate.
  • Lifelong learning: You build an understanding of application architectures and technical concepts to effectively analyze issues and communicate potential root causes
  • Shape the future: You contribute to the evolution of testing processes by supporting the transition from manual testing to automated testing, including the use of AI-driven 

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study Field: You are currently studying Computer Science, Software Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a related technical field
  • Interests: You have a strong interest in software quality assurance, testing methodologies and exploring alternative user flows and edge cases
  • (Work) experience: You ideally gained first experience with manual software testing, writing test cases or documenting defects in a structured manner
  • Skills: You possess basic programming knowledge, ideally in .NET and Blazor, are familiar with Git and are interested in automated testing with Playwright; experience with AR applications is a plus
  • Work Style: You work in a structured, detail-oriented and analytical way, question expected behavior and translate findings into clear and reproducible recommendations
  • Language Skills: You have strong written and spoken English communication skills; German language skills are considered an advantage

Please attach the following documents to your application:

·       CV in English

·       Certificate of enrollment at university

·       Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

·       High school report

  

Important information:

·       Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week.

·       Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

·       You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.




#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Mafalda Porto

title: Working Student - Procurement and Logistic Support (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


 Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


• Shape the future: Support logistics and organization of competitor semiconductor components

• Keep the overview: Process sample requests from internal customers

• Reliable work: Communicate with suppliers, global team and procurement partners 

• Identify needs: Maintain and update data in the Out Systems database

• Focus on the future: Support inventory tracking, documentation and components storage 


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


• Study Field: Currently enrolled in Business Administration, Logistic and Supply Chain Management, Industrial Engineering and Management, or related fields

• Skills: Strong communication, organizational, and teamwork skills

• Working style: Proactive, reliable, and detail-oriented 

• Experience: Initial experience in Logistics, Purchasing, Procurement or Supply Chain is a plus; general knowledge of semiconductors and the electronics industry is an advantage

• Language Skills: Business-fluent English skills. German language skills are an advantage


Please attach the following documents to your application:

• CV in English

• Certificate of enrollment at university

• Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

• High school report

  

Important information:

• Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 

• Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

  • Shape the Future: You contribute to portfolio management activities and support the evaluation of product and market opportunities
  • Keep Track of Everything: You coordinate product samples and ensure smooth collaboration across relevant stakeholders and functions
  • Convince Others with Your Words: You prepare presentations and communicate insights, recommendations, and results to different target groups
  • Stakeholder Management: You collaborate with cross-functional teams and support communication across various functions and channels

Your profile

  • Study Field: You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Business Informatics, Physics, Marketing, Economics, or a comparable field
  • Interests: You have a strong interest in semiconductors, electronics, and product management
  • Work Style: You stand out through your analytical, data-driven, and structured way of working and your ability to solve problems independently
  • Personality: You possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with different functions and teams 
  • Skills: You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Language Skills: You have excellent written and spoken English skills

position_details_raw.jobDescription:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Strength in Numbers: You support product management activities through data analysis, customer and opportunity analysis, and market research
  • Stay up to Date: You conduct competitor analyses and monitor market developments, trends, and opportunities in the semiconductor and electronics industry
  • Shape the Future: You contribute to portfolio management activities and support the evaluation of product and market opportunities
  • Keep Track of Everything: You coordinate product samples and ensure smooth collaboration across relevant stakeholders and functions
  • Convince Others with Your Words: You prepare presentations and communicate insights, recommendations, and results to different target groups
  • Stakeholder Management: You collaborate with cross-functional teams and support communication across various functions and channels

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study Field: You are currently pursuing a degree in Industrial Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Business Administration, Business Informatics, Physics, Marketing, Economics, or a comparable field
  • Interests: You have a strong interest in semiconductors, electronics, and product management
  • Work Style: You stand out through your analytical, data-driven, and structured way of working and your ability to solve problems independently
  • Personality: You possess strong communication and stakeholder management skills and enjoy collaborating with different functions and teams 
  • Skills: You are proficient in Microsoft Office applications
  • Language Skills: You have excellent written and spoken English skills


Please attach the following documents to your application:

  •  CV in English
  •  Certificate of enrollment at university
  •  Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  •  High school report

  

Important information:

  • Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
  • Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree program. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
  • You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


 Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


• Focus on the future: Introduction and Training in Infineon’s internal code generation framework (metagen/metartl, python based) 

• Identify needs: Introduction to asynchronous elements and asynchronous CPU design

• Reliable work: Introduction into CPU subsystems 

• Shape the future: Integration of peripherals into an async processor



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


• Study Field: Enrolled in a master program in Electrical Engineering, Microelectronics, Computer Engineering, Embedded Systems or a related field

• Circuit Knowledge: Background knowledge on Digital Circuits, based on design, modeling, synthesis and simulation with Verilog and VHDL

• Programming Skills: High degree of proficiency with programming tools, especially Python, Linux, and Git

• Previous Experience: Past experience with Model-Driven Engineering is a plus, particularly metamodeling and code generation

• Personality: Curiosity and openness as well as an interest in learning and trying out new things. Self-driven and critical thinker

• Affinity: Ability to address challenges from a practical point of view and critical thinking

• Language skills: Professional level of written and spoken English


Please attach the following documents to your application:

• CV in English

• Certificate of enrollment at university

• Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

• High school report

  

Important information:

• Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 

• Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

• You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

title: Working Student - Project Office and Digitalization (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


In this role, you will support the team in reporting, stakeholder management, and digitalization initiatives while driving innovation and efficiency at Infineon Regensburg! 


  • Reporting support: You support the monthly reporting by gathering information from stakeholders and distributing it in the systems (excel on Ishare, online database) 
  • Digitalization: You assist in digitalization of reports with Tableau and SAP updating them on monthly basis. You support testing, user documentation and the introduction of improved digital processes. 
  • Stakeholder management: Coordinate and report on investment-related topics within the department, ensuring effective communication and alignment with key stakeholders, including internal teams and management. 
  • Communication support: You take over small additional tasks, e.g. improving/ creating the presentations, updating the communication and learning material 



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


We are looking for a motivated and proactive student who enjoys working with data, collaborating with stakeholders, and making improvements through innovative ideas and digital solutions.

 

  • Study field: You are currently studying mathematics/information technology or similar studies with focus on digitalization with good results 
  • Experience: You already gained some experience in Excel, PowerPoint as well as digitalization/data analysis, being able to try out new concepts and thinking out of the box

title: Working Student – Humanoid Robotics Marketing & Operations (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role

As part of the Humanoid Robotics Marketing & Ecosystem team, you will support strategic communication, market research, and operational execution — enabling senior marketers to focus on high-impact tasks in one of the most dynamic technology domains.

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Take Responsibility: You will prepare and update PowerPoint decks using Infineon standards and visuals for reports, briefings, and stakeholder meetings. 
  • Thorough Planning: You will schedule and coordinate meetings, prepare agendas and pre-reads, capture action items, and organize follow-ups. 
  • Teamwork makes the Dream Work: You will assist in content creation and internal alignment. 
  • Keep an Overview: You will conduct market & ecosystem research. 

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study Field: You are currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s program (e.g. Business, Industrial Engineering, Communications, Technology Management, or comparable). 
  • (Work) Experience: You are proficient in Microsoft Office (especially PowerPoint and Excel).  
  • Way of Working: You are structured, reliable, and eager to take ownership of tasks and are able to work independently. 
  • Personality: You are curious about robotics, AI, or technology ecosystems and have good communication skills. 
  • Language Skills: You are fluent in English (strong written & verbal skills). German skills are a plus. 


Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report


Important Information:

  • Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
  • Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree program. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
  • You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

title: Working Student - Digital Marketing & Video Content (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


 Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


We’re looking for a Working Student in Digital Marketing & Video Content to join our Customer Experience team within Central Marketing in the Automotive segment.

You’ll support our Digital Marketing activities with a strong focus on video creation and production, working across the full journey from the first idea to the finished content.

This is a hands-on role. We’re looking for someone who likes to take ownership, make things happen and turn ideas into results!


• Video support: Support video shoots with camera work, lighting, sound and on-set production

• Post production: Independently edit and post-produce different video formats

• Support editing: Turn longer content into short, platform-ready cuts for different digital and social channels

• Visual assets: Create and edit thumbnails, images, graphics and other visual assets

• Video content: Create video content from idea to publish-ready asset, including concept development, recording, editing and post-production

• Fresh perspective: Bring your own ideas for new video formats, stories and digital content

• Support post event content: Support video activities around customer events, including recording and post-event content

• Organization skills: Help organize and maintain video footage, project files and digital assets



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


We’d love to see something you’ve created! Feel free to share a link to a video, social media project, university project, portfolio or any other content that shows us your creative side.

If you enjoy experimenting with video, follow digital trends, have opinions about what makes content engaging and want the opportunity to create content in a professional marketing environment, we’d love to hear from you.


• Study Field: Currently enrolled in a degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Business, Media, or related fields

• Experience: Experience with video recording, cutting, editing and post-production; Know how to turn raw footage into content that is ready to publish; experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar tools

• Skills: Comfortable working with a camera of any type and have a basic understanding of lighting and sound; a good eye for visual storytelling, composition and engaging digital content

• Interests: interested in digital marketing, social media and new content formats

• Personality: Strong DIY mentality: you enjoy figuring things out, trying things and getting them done

• Way of working: Work proactively and independently and take ownership of your tasks

•Organized and can work toward deadlines

• Language skills: Comfortable communicating and working in English

Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

You’ll support our Digital Marketing activities with a strong focus on video creation and production, working across the full journey from the first idea to the finished content.

This is a hands-on role. We’re looking for someone who likes to take ownership, make things happen and turn ideas into results!


• Video support: Support video shoots with camera work, lighting, sound and on-set production

• Post production: Independently edit and post-produce different video formats

• Support editing: Turn longer content into short, platform-ready cuts for different digital and social channels

• Visual assets: Create and edit thumbnails, images, graphics and other visual assets

• Video content: Create video content from idea to publish-ready asset, including concept development, recording, editing and post-production

• Fresh perspective: Bring your own ideas for new video formats, stories and digital content

• Support post event content: Support video activities around customer events, including recording and post-event content

• Organization skills: Help organize and maintain video footage, project files and digital assets



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


We’d love to see something you’ve created! Feel free to share a link to a video, social media project, university project, portfolio or any other content that shows us your creative side.

If you enjoy experimenting with video, follow digital trends, have opinions about what makes content engaging and want the opportunity to create content in a professional marketing environment, we’d love to hear from you.


• Study Field: Currently enrolled in a degree in Marketing, Digital Marketing, Communications, Business, Media, or related fields

• Experience: Experience with video recording, cutting, editing and post-production; Know how to turn raw footage into content that is ready to publish; experience with video editing software such as Adobe Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, Final Cut Pro or similar tools

• Skills: Comfortable working with a camera of any type and have a basic understanding of lighting and sound; a good eye for visual storytelling, composition and engaging digital content

• Interests: interested in digital marketing, social media and new content formats

• Personality: Strong DIY mentality: you enjoy figuring things out, trying things and getting them done

• Way of working: Work proactively and independently and take ownership of your tasks

•Organized and can work toward deadlines

• Language skills: Comfortable communicating and working in English



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together!

Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

You will support our project teams in the development of modern power semiconductor modules based on silicon and silicon carbide, but also in economic disciplines such as controlling and marketing. You can apply your academic knowledge in the following areas, among others:

Focus on electrical engineering

  • electrical characterization of semiconductor components
  • evaluation and analysis of electrical measurements
  • design of electrical circuits
  • carrying out electrical simulation
  • modeling electrical systems

Focus on mechanics and design

  • mechanical conception and design of power semiconductor modules
  • development of production and automation concepts
  • carrying out thermo-mechanical simulations
  • modeling of mechanical and thermal systems
  • development of cooling concepts for power semiconductor components

Focus on materials and reliability

  • development of processes and systems for assembly and connection technology
  • characterization of materials used in assembly and connection technologyi
  • investigating the fatigue of materials as a result of environmental stresses
  • modeling the reliability of power semiconductor modules
  • failure analysis and clarification of failure mechanisms of power semiconductor modules
  • investigation of insulating and passivating materials

Focus on marketing and controlling

  • development of technical and commercial product and segment strategies
  • planning and implementation of product launch strategies
  • market and competition analysis
  • price analysis and pricing
  • development of communication strategies

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Study field: Currently studying electrical engineering, physics, mechanical engineering, industrial engineering, materials science, chemistry or a comparable discipline
  • Personality: Technical affinity, independent way of working and ability to work in a team
  • Language skills: Confident communication in German and English

Please include the following documents in your application:

  • curriculum vitae
  • certificate of enrollment
  • current overview of grades (not older than 6 months)
  • school leaving certificate
  • for compulsory internships and final theses: Extract from the study regulations governing this module

Please note that the application for this position is an unsolicited application, i.e. there is no specific position yet. If there is a match, this will subsequently be created for you in the desired department. We ask for your patience in this regard, as once we have received your application, we must first check which department your profile is suitable for. The specialist department will then check a specific job opportunity and will also create the conditions for implementation (including definition of the position, financial approvals, provision of workspace, etc.). Of course, we will endeavor to provide you with an answer to your application as quickly as possible. You will receive final feedback from us after a total period of 6-8 weeks at the latest.

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Working Student - Digital Functional Verification (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role  


As our Digital Functional Verification Working Student, you will support our verification team in exploring and applying cutting-edge verification technologies, while gaining hands-on experience in real project work at the intersection of digital design and AI-driven innovation.


  • Experience research: Research and evaluate state-of-the-art verification concepts including SystemVerilog UVM, functional verification, and formal verification
  • Experience project work: Support verification and automation tasks within ongoing projects and help drive topics to completion
  • Focus on the future: Explore AI-based methods and applications for functional and formal verification in a practical project environment
  • Shape the future: Conduct research on how AI can improve verification efficiency, coverage, and analysis
  • Teamwork Is Dreamwork: Work closely with experienced verification engineers and contribute to real project work

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed    


  • Study Field: Currently enrolled in a technical degree program (e.g., electrical engineering, computer engineering, or computer science)
  • Way of working:
    • Strong problem-solving skills, with the ability to analyze complex technical issues and develop creative solutions
    • Collaborative team player with a proactive attitude who enjoys working closely with experienced engineers
    • Structured approach to work with strong organizational skills
  • Technical skills:
    • Solid foundation in object-oriented programming and familiarity with Python and scripting languages
    • Good knowledge of digital circuit design principles, along with practical experience in Verilog and SystemVerilog and strong debugging skills
    • Familiarity with EDA tools (simulators, waveform debug, lint, formal) is a plus
  • Nice-to-Have Skills: Prior knowledge of SoC verification processes, especially SystemVerilog UVM, is highly preferred
  • Language skills: Good written and spoken English skills

 

Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

Important information:

  •   Working part-time: The focus is on studies. Therefore, working student is possible during the lecture period with a maximum of 20 hours per week.
  •   Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: You must be enrolled and the examination results or modules of your studies must not have been completed yet, so that you can still work in our team for at least 6 months. You must also not be in a semester of leave.
  • You should live close to the site: It is important for us to work with you on site and to integrate you into the team. You should therefore be able to come to the site regularly.

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.



Contact: Rahel Tews

 Are you in?

title: Working Student - Change Management & Communication Support (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


• Communication & Content: Maintain and update the intranet page of the AI Transformation Initiative (content, structure, up-to-date information)

• Newsletter creation: Write newsletter articles and news stories on projects, milestones, use cases, and success stories

• Video making: Create explainer videos that make complex AI topics simple and engaging 

• Leadership Communication & Video: Plan and support video shoots with senior leaders, from concept and scheduling to post-production

• Script preparation: Help prepare scripts, interview questions, and talking points, and coordinate with video editors or external partners

• Change Management & Stakeholder Engagement: Reach out to stakeholders across business units and functions to collect information, updates, and best practices

• Stakeholder analyses & communication: Support stakeholder analyses communication plans, and change activities (e.g., town halls, workshops, pulse surveys)

• Feedback: Help consolidate feedback and sentiment from the organization into clear insights for the team



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


• Study Field: Currently enrolled at a university in a field such as Communication Science, Business Administration, Business Psychology, Media, Information Management, or a related subject

• Language skills: Excellent command of English, good knowledge of German is a plus

• Skills: Strong, creative writing skills and a sense for audience-oriented communication

• Experience: Initial experience in video creation and editing (e.g., Canva, Adobe Premiere, CapCut, Camtasia, or similar)

• Interests: Genuine interest in AI, digitalization, and change processes 

• Personality: Confident communicator who is comfortable approaching stakeholders and senior leaders

• Way of working: Structured, proactive, and reliable working style

• Nice to have: Experience with intranet/CMS tools (e.g., SharePoint), and first practical experience in communications, PR, marketing, or project work


Please attach the following documents to your application:

• CV in English

• Certificate of enrollment at university

• Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

• High school report

  

Important information:

• Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 

• Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

• You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Bárbara Moreira

title: Working Student - Project Documents Management (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Experience project management: You support project activities by organizing surveys of existing documentation practices across different sites and consolidating recurring documentation gaps and inconsistencies 
  • Holistic overview: You create, maintain, and continuously improve a Frontend Engineering (FE) documentation inventory to ensure transparency and accessibility of project-related information 
  • Keep track of everything: You monitor open requirements, questions, action items, and stakeholder feedback while ensuring timely follow-up 
  • Stakeholder management: You collaborate with different project stakeholders and support communication between sites to align documentation standards and requirements
  • Organizational Skills: You prepare workshop materials, status reports, and working documents to support project meetings and decision-making processes
  • Shape the future: You develop supporting documentation, templates, and rollout materials that enable the successful implementation of documentation standards across sites

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study Field: You are currently enrolled in a degree program in Mechatronics, Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, or a comparable field 
  • Work Style: You approach your tasks in a structured, analytical, and independent manner while maintaining a high level of quality and accuracy 
  • Personality: You communicate effectively, enjoy working in a team, and have a strong understanding of technical concepts 
  • Availability: You are available to work up to 20 hours per week 
  • Skills: You have knowledge of Project Management and Requirements Engineering and ideally have experience with Windchill, SQL, Agentic AI, GitHub Copilot, MCP, and/or programming languages such as JavaScript
  • Language Skills: You have very good written and spoken English skills, German is a plus


Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

Important information:

  • Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week. 
  •  Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.
  • You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate to the team.

 

Further links:

  • Find out what we are looking for in your CV
  • Find out how the student application process works with us
  • Discover our student website

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Anne Bergner

title: Working Student - Electrical characterization and data analysis (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Take responsibility: Hands-on electrical characterization of state-of-the-art SiC power devices
  • Keep the overview: Interpretation of results and identification of underlying mechanisms
  • Shape the future: Performance comparison between different device embodiments and test conditions
  • Data is everything: Data processing, analysis, and visualization (e.g., curve extraction, parameter trends)

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  • Study field: You are a student in Electrical Engineering, Physics, or a related field
  • Skills: Basic lab experience and programming/data tools (e.g., Python/Matlab/Excel) are a plus
  • Interest: Interest in power semiconductors, device characterization, and data analysis
  • Language skills: Fluent in english. German is a plus

Please attach the following documents to your application:

·       CV in English

·       Certificate of enrollment at university

·       Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)

·       High school report

  

Important information:

·       Working part-time: The focus is on studies. That’s why working as a student employee during lecture period is limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week.

·       Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for at least 6 months.

title: Hardware System Verification Intern
description_html:
The Hardware System Verification Intern will support system-level hardware verification and testing, working closely with hardware engineers to validate the functionality, performance, and robustness of hardware systems.


The role is primarily hands-on and laboratory based. The intern will learn the system, execute tests, investigate unexpected behavior, collect and analyze measurement data, and support engineers in identifying and resolving hardware issues.


The ideal candidate is curious, hands-on, systematic, and eager to understand why things work or fail, rather than simply completing a predefined test checklist.



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Work closely with hardware engineers to perform system-level hardware verification and validation.
  • Set up hardware, test boards, instruments, power supplies, loads, cables, and other equipment required for verification.
  • Execute verification according to test plans and defined test conditions.
  • Perform functional, electrical, interface, and system-level testing of hardware.
  • Use laboratory equipment to measure and capture relevant electrical signals and system behavior.
  • Record test conditions, measurement results, abnormalities, and observations in a structured way.
  • Analyze test data and compare results against expected system performance or specifications.
  • Support troubleshooting and root-cause investigation when abnormal behavior or test failures are observed.
  • Repeat and modify test conditions to help isolate hardware, interface, configuration, or system-related issues.
  • Work with engineers to continuously improve test methods, test coverage, and test efficiency.
  • Prepare concise test reports, data summaries, plots, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and disciplined working approach in the laboratory.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

Education

  • Current university student in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation, Power Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

Technical

  • Good understanding of basic electronics, circuits, and electrical measurements.
  • Comfortable with hands-on hardware work and willing to work regularly in a laboratory environment.
  • Basic experience using common laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and electronic loads.
  • Able to read basic schematics, block diagrams, datasheets, and hardware specifications.
  • Experience with PCB bring-up, soldering, debugging, or hardware testing is an advantage.
  • Basic data-processing skills using Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools are an advantage.
  • Knowledge of power electronics, embedded systems, semiconductor devices, or common hardware interfaces is a plus.

Personal Attributes

  • Curious: wants to understand why a result occurs, not only whether it passes or fails.
  • Hands-on: enjoys working directly with boards, equipment, probes, cables, and real systems.
  • Systematic: changes test conditions carefully and records results clearly.
  • Analytical: able to connect measurement results with possible hardware or system behavior.
  • Proactive: willing to investigate unexpected results and propose the next experiment.
  • Collaborative: works effectively with hardware engineers and communicates observations clearly.
  • Willing to learn: comfortable working with unfamiliar hardware and developing new technical skills.

position_details_raw.name: Hardware System Verification Intern
position_details_raw.jobDescription:
The Hardware System Verification Intern will support system-level hardware verification and testing, working closely with hardware engineers to validate the functionality, performance, and robustness of hardware systems.


The role is primarily hands-on and laboratory based. The intern will learn the system, execute tests, investigate unexpected behavior, collect and analyze measurement data, and support engineers in identifying and resolving hardware issues.


The ideal candidate is curious, hands-on, systematic, and eager to understand why things work or fail, rather than simply completing a predefined test checklist.



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Work closely with hardware engineers to perform system-level hardware verification and validation.
  • Set up hardware, test boards, instruments, power supplies, loads, cables, and other equipment required for verification.
  • Execute verification according to test plans and defined test conditions.
  • Perform functional, electrical, interface, and system-level testing of hardware.
  • Use laboratory equipment to measure and capture relevant electrical signals and system behavior.
  • Record test conditions, measurement results, abnormalities, and observations in a structured way.
  • Analyze test data and compare results against expected system performance or specifications.
  • Support troubleshooting and root-cause investigation when abnormal behavior or test failures are observed.
  • Repeat and modify test conditions to help isolate hardware, interface, configuration, or system-related issues.
  • Work with engineers to continuously improve test methods, test coverage, and test efficiency.
  • Prepare concise test reports, data summaries, plots, and technical documentation.
  • Maintain a safe, organized, and disciplined working approach in the laboratory.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

Education

  • Current university student in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Automation, Power Electronics, Mechatronics, or a related engineering discipline.

Technical

  • Good understanding of basic electronics, circuits, and electrical measurements.
  • Comfortable with hands-on hardware work and willing to work regularly in a laboratory environment.
  • Basic experience using common laboratory equipment such as oscilloscopes, multimeters, power supplies, and electronic loads.
  • Able to read basic schematics, block diagrams, datasheets, and hardware specifications.
  • Experience with PCB bring-up, soldering, debugging, or hardware testing is an advantage.
  • Basic data-processing skills using Excel, MATLAB, Python, or similar tools are an advantage.
  • Knowledge of power electronics, embedded systems, semiconductor devices, or common hardware interfaces is a plus.

Personal Attributes

  • Curious: wants to understand why a result occurs, not only whether it passes or fails.
  • Hands-on: enjoys working directly with boards, equipment, probes, cables, and real systems.
  • Systematic: changes test conditions carefully and records results clearly.
  • Analytical: able to connect measurement results with possible hardware or system behavior.
  • Proactive: willing to investigate unexpected results and propose the next experiment.
  • Collaborative: works effectively with hardware engineers and communicates observations clearly.
  • Willing to learn: comfortable working with unfamiliar hardware and developing new technical skills.

title: Werkstudent - Produktentwicklung Automotive MOSFETs (w/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.


Bereit Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen? Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln. Egal ob Praktikum, Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder als Trainee - bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei.


Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten in Deiner neuen Rolle

  • Gestalte die Zukunft: Du unterstützt bei der Entwicklung von Automotive MOSFETs 
  • Forschung erleben: Du führst Simulationen zur Bestimmung der Produktperformance durch und vergleichst diese mit elektrischen Messungen 
  • Daten sind alles: Du analysierst Daten aus elektrischen und thermischen Simulationen zur Bewertung der Produkteigenschaften 
  • Lebenslanges Lernen: Du unterstützt das Entwicklungsteam bei anfallenden Aufgaben wie der Auswertung von Testdaten

Dein Profil
Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten, die dir zum Erfolg verhelfen

  • Studiengang: Du studierst aktuell Elektrotechnik, Physik oder einen vergleichbaren technischen Studiengang 
  • (Arbeits)Erfahrung: Du bringst idealerweise erste Programmierkenntnisse in Python mit und hast Interesse an simulationsgestützter Produktentwicklung
  • Arbeitsweise: Du zeichnest dich durch eine selbstständige, zuverlässige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie eine sehr gute Kommunikationsfähigkeit aus 
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du bist an einer langfristigen Zusammenarbeit interessiert oder möchtest deine Bachelor- oder Masterarbeit in Zusammenarbeit mit uns durchführen 
  • Skills: Du bist sicher im Umgang mit MS Office, Windows und idealerweise mit Copilot
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Bitte liefere uns folgende Unterlagen in Deiner Bewerbung mit:

  • Lebenslauf
  •  Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  •  Aktuelle Notenübersicht (nicht älter als 6 Monate)
  •  Schulabschlusszeugnis

Wichtige Informationen:

  • Arbeiten in Teilzeit: Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Studium. Deshalb ist die Werkstudierendentätigkeit während der Vorlesungszeit maximal mit 20 Stunden pro Woche möglich.
  • Ordentlich immatrikulierte Studierende sind bei uns herzlich willkommen: Um als Werkstudent*in bei uns zu arbeiten, musst du an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert sein und noch nicht alle Prüfungsleistungen oder Module Deines Studiums abgeschlossen haben. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich mindestens 6 Monate in unserem Team begrüßen zu können. Bitte beachte, dass Du nicht im Urlaubssemester sein darfst. 
  • Du solltest nahe am Einsatzort wohnen: Für eine gute Zusammenarbeit ist es uns wichtig, dass Du regelmäßig zum Standort kommen kannst, um Dich in das Team zu integrieren.

 

Weiterführende Links:

  • Finde heraus, was uns an Deinem Lebenslauf wichtig ist
  •  Finde heraus, wie der studentische Bewerbungsprozess bei uns abläuft
  • Entdecke unsere Studierenden-Webseite



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. Are you in?
Als ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Halbleiterlösungen für Power-Systeme und IoT ermöglichen wir wegweisende Lösungen für grüne und effiziente Energie, saubere und sichere Mobilität sowie ein intelligentes und sicheres IoT. Gemeinsam treiben wir Innovation und den Erfolg unserer Kund*innen voran. Gleichzeitig kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeitenden und bestärken sie darin, ihre ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. Hilf uns, das Leben einfacher, sicherer und nachhaltiger zu machen.

 
Unser Ziel ist es, das beste Infineon für alle zu erschaffen.
Wir möchten durch Vielfalt und Inklusion das beste Infineon für alle erschaffen. Wir schätzen Bewerbende so, wie sie sind, und bieten ein Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Offenheit, Respekt und Chancengleichheit basiert. 

Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir Dich, dich zu bewerben.

Bitte teile uns mit, falls Du während des Bewerbungsprozesses besondere Vorkehrungen benötigst.

Erfahre mehr über unsere verschiedenen Kontaktmöglichkeiten und über Diversity & Inclusion bei Infineon.


Anne Bergner

title: Internship - Test Engineering Support (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Support: Work with Test Engineers in day-to-day tasks including sample logistics, sample testing, and basic data analysis

  • Collaboration: Coordinate priorities and status with Test Engineers and peers


Further Information:
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time  (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: 12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Actively studying a degree in electronics, microelectronics, or mechatronics 

  • Language Skills: English: good; German: a plus
  • Mindset: Strong orientation toward science, AI and engineering topics
  • Mathematics: Demonstrable ability in mathematics and engineering principles
  • Analytics: Good data analysis capability and engineering problem-solving skills
  • Office Tools: Familiar with Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and Word
  • Programming: Knowledge in C++ or Java is a plus

Additional information

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Sabrina Nindler

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Sabrina Nindler

title: Internship - Lab Verification Engineer in the AMS Lab of the Development Center Villach (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

In a rapidly digitizing world, the interfaces between analog and digital domains are essential enablers of modern technology. Join the largest Analog-Mixed-Signal (AMS) verification laboratory team at Infineon, dedicated to analog and digital measurement. Our labs verify a wide range of devices, including:

  • Analog blocks in Infineon microcontrollers
  • Analog to Digital (ADC) and Digital to Analog (DAC) converters
  • High-speed interfaces and High Precision Oscillators and PLLs
  • Power Management Systems (PMS) and Battery Management Systems (BMS)
  • DCDC Converters for low voltage applications and Linear Voltage Regulators (LDOs)
  • RF blocks for radar systems and Bias & Control circuits for 5G antennas

Key responsibilities in your new role

Take this opportunity to expand your theoretical knowledge and acquire practical, hands-on experience in areas such as:

  • Analog-Mixed-Signal Integrated Circuits: Understand and work with semiconductor integrated circuits
  • Measurement Equipment and Techniques: Gain experience with the latest AMS measurement tools and acquire expertise in AMS measurement techniques
  • Board-Level Skills: Learn board assembly, rework, and soldering
  • Debugging and Problem Solving: Develop skills to identify root causes of unexpected behavior and understand parasitic effects on circuit performance
  • Data Management and Automation: Handle big data, conduct post-processing, and automate lab test setups
  • Effective Communication: Prepare, present, and document measurement results according to high-quality standards
  • Comprehensive Hands-On Experience: Combine theoretical knowledge with practical application across diverse AMS areas


You will also benefit from working in a dynamic, international environment with more than 100 previous student interns, many of whom have joined the lab or Infineon’s global teams as engineers.

Ready for a challenge? Submit your application and become part of our vibrant lab community!

Further Information
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 6 months



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Educational Background: Enrolled as a student in Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field
  • Lab Equipment Expertise: Familiarity with using laboratory equipment
  • Programming Knowledge: Understanding of programming languages such as C, C#, or C++
  • Language Skills: Good English skills
  • Internship Commitment: Willingness to complete an internship of at least 6 months, preferably 1 year or more

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

  • Motivation letter
  • CV
  • Certificate of matriculation at a university
  • Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)
  • Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)
  • Reference letter (optional)



Contact:
    Nico Steinhauser

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. We base our recruiting decisions on the applicant´s experience and skills. Learn more about our various contact channels.
We look forward to receiving your resume, even if you do not entirely meet all the requirements of the job posting.
Please let your recruiter know if they need to pay special attention to something in order to enable your participation in the interview process.
Click here for more information about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.
