title: Werkstudent - Productivity Improvement Frontend (w/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.


Bereit Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen? Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln. Als Werkstudent*in bist Du bei uns mittendrin statt nur dabei.


Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten


  • Ganzheitlicher Überblick: Du kümmerst dich um das fortlaufende Tracking von Produktivitäts-Projekten im Frontend Dresden, unterstützt bei der Erstellung von Reports und bereitest regelmäßige Review-Meetings vor

  • Daten sind alles: Du unterstützt bei der Durchführung von Analysen, um Potentiale in den Bereichen Material- und Energieeffizienz zu identifizieren

  • Persönliche Entwicklung: Du lernst den Umgang mit Visual Studio Code, GitHub, Confluence, Knime und Tableau kennen

  • Verantwortung übernehmen: Du übernimmst eigenständig kleine Projekte und dokumentierst den Fortschritt, um die Produktivität zu sichern(Nachhaltigkeit)

  • Gestalte die Zukunft: Du trägst maßgeblich zur Verbesserung der Produktivität und Nachhaltigkeit am Standortes Dresden bei


Dein Profil
Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten, die dir zum Erfolg verhelfen


  • Studiengang: Du studierst aktuell in einem MINT-Studiengang oder ähnliches

  • Skills: Du bist versiert in MS Office und SQL-Kenntnisse sind von Vorteil
  • Persönlichkeit: Du zeichnest dich durch deine proaktive Arbeitsweiseaus, arbeitest organisiert und selbstständig
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift


Bitte liefere uns folgende Unterlagen in Deiner Bewerbung mit:

  • Lebenslauf
  • Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  • Aktuelle Notenübersicht (nicht älter als 6 Monate)
  • Schulabschlusszeugnis

 

Wichtige Informationen:

  • Arbeiten in Teilzeit: Der Schwerpunkt liegt auf dem Studium. Deshalb ist die Werkstudierendentätigkeit während der Vorlesungszeit maximal mit 20 Stunden pro Woche möglich.
  • Ordentlich immatrikulierte Studierende sind bei uns herzlich willkommen: Um als Werkstudent*in bei uns zu arbeiten, musst du an einer Hochschule immatrikuliert sein und noch nicht alle Prüfungsleistungen oder Module Deines Studiums abgeschlossen haben. Wir freuen uns darauf, Dich mindestens 6 Monate in unserem Team begrüßen zu können. Bitte beachte, dass Du nicht im Urlaubssemester sein darfst. 
  • Du solltest nahe am Einsatzort wohnen: Für eine gute Zusammenarbeit ist es uns wichtig, dass Du regelmäßig zum Standort kommen kannst, um Dich in das Team zu integrieren.



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. Are you in?
Als ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Halbleiterlösungen für Power-Systeme und IoT ermöglichen wir wegweisende Lösungen für grüne und effiziente Energie, saubere und sichere Mobilität sowie ein intelligentes und sicheres IoT. Gemeinsam treiben wir Innovation und den Erfolg unserer Kund*innen voran. Gleichzeitig kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeitenden und bestärken sie darin, ihre ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. Hilf uns, das Leben einfacher, sicherer und nachhaltiger zu machen.

 
Unser Ziel ist es, das beste Infineon für alle zu erschaffen.
Wir möchten durch Vielfalt und Inklusion das beste Infineon für alle erschaffen. Wir schätzen Bewerbende so, wie sie sind, und bieten ein Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Offenheit, Respekt und Chancengleichheit basiert. 

Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir Dich, dich zu bewerben.

Bitte teile uns mit, falls Du während des Bewerbungsprozesses besondere Vorkehrungen benötigst.

Erfahre mehr über unsere verschiedenen Kontaktmöglichkeiten und über Diversity & Inclusion bei Infineon.


Lara Praust

  • Du solltest nahe am Einsatzort wohnen: Für eine gute Zusammenarbeit ist es uns wichtig, dass Du regelmäßig zum Standort kommen kannst, um Dich in das Team zu integrieren.



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. Are you in?
Als ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Halbleiterlösungen für Power-Systeme und IoT ermöglichen wir wegweisende Lösungen für grüne und effiziente Energie, saubere und sichere Mobilität sowie ein intelligentes und sicheres IoT. Gemeinsam treiben wir Innovation und den Erfolg unserer Kund*innen voran. Gleichzeitig kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeitenden und bestärken sie darin, ihre ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. Hilf uns, das Leben einfacher, sicherer und nachhaltiger zu machen.

 
Unser Ziel ist es, das beste Infineon für alle zu erschaffen.
Wir möchten durch Vielfalt und Inklusion das beste Infineon für alle erschaffen. Wir schätzen Bewerbende so, wie sie sind, und bieten ein Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Offenheit, Respekt und Chancengleichheit basiert. 

Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir Dich, dich zu bewerben.

Bitte teile uns mit, falls Du während des Bewerbungsprozesses besondere Vorkehrungen benötigst.

Erfahre mehr über unsere verschiedenen Kontaktmöglichkeiten und über Diversity & Inclusion bei Infineon.


Lara Praust

title: Praktikum – Produkttestung & Zuverlässigkeitsprüfung (w/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.


Bereit Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen? Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln.


Egal ob Praktikum, Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder als Trainee - bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei.


Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten

  • Entwicklung und Durchführung elektrischer Modultests: Einrichtung komplexer Testumgebungen mit verschiedenen Modultypen und Testbedingungen.
  • Datenanalyse und Optimierung der automatisierten Datenerfassung: Auswertung von Testläufen und Verbesserung der Datenverarbeitung und -visualisierung.
  • Entwicklung von Adaptern und Leiterplatten: Entwicklung neuer Adapter und elektrischer Leiterplatten mit Fokus auf praxisorientiertes Design und Herstellbarkeit.
  • Information der Kollegen: Dokumentation der Methodik und der Ergebnisse sowie professionelle Präsentation der Optimierungsergebnisse in regelmäßigen Besprechungen und Berichten.

Dein Profil
Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten, die Dir zum Erfolg verhelfen

  • Studienfach: Immatrikulierter Studierender in einem relevanten Studiengang wie Elektrotechnik, Physik, Informatik oder einem verwandten ingenieurwissenschaftlichen Fachgebiet.
  • Fähigkeiten: Ausgeprägte Fähigkeiten bei der Vorbereitung experimenteller, elektrischer Set-Ups, der Durchführung von Experimenten und der Datenanalyse
  • Digitalisierung und Datenvisualisierung: Erfahrung in der Datenvisualisierung und ein starkes Interesse an der Gestaltung der Schnittstelle zwischen Maschinen und Datenbanken mit verschiedenen Programmiersprachen.
  • Persönlichkeit: Zuverlässigkeit, analytisches Denkvermögen, Teamfähigkeit und die Fähigkeit, komplexe technische Zusammenhänge verständlich zu vermitteln.
  • Verfügbarkeit: Die gewünschte Dauer des Praktikums beträgt 3–6 Monate vor Ort bei Infineon in Warstein.
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse sind zwingend erforderlich. Englisch ist ein Plus.



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Luca Schulte

title: Internship - Support in Automation Maintenance (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Organization: Assist with organizational tasks for the maintenance department
  • Technical Support: Contribute to mechanical and electrical topics, including related technical matters
  • Reporting and Analysis: Prepare information for reports and contribute to analytical tasks
  • Contractors and Assets: Assist with contractor supervision and asset tracking
  • Maintenance Activities: Contribute to technical evaluations, fault analyses, preventive maintenance activities, and continuous improvement and digitization projects

Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min. 12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Currently pursuing a degree in mechatronics, electrical engineering, mechanical engineering, automation, industrial engineering or a similar field
  • Technical Knowledge: Basic understanding of mechanical and electrical systems
  • Skills: Strong analytical and organizational skills, with confident use of MS Office
  • Working Style: Able to work independently and reliably, with a hands-on mindset and comfort supporting technical activities on the shop floor and organizational tasks such as reporting and contractor coordination
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English, very good German skills

Additional information

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

title: Praktikum - Global Talent Marketing and Employer Branding (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Bereit Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen? Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln. Egal ob Praktikum, Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder als Trainee - bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei.

Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten


  • Gestalte die Zukunft: Du unterstützt bei der Konzeption und Erstellung von Printmaterialien sowie bei der Gestaltung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Merchandise-Produkte und Website-Inhalte 
  • Be social: Du bringst dich in unsere Social-Media-Aktivitäten ein. Dabei entwickelst du eigene Ideen und behältst aktuelle Social-Media-Trends im Blick
  • Teamwork is dreamwork: Du wirkst bei der Organisation und Umsetzung von Events und vielfältigen Marketingmaßnahmen zur Stärkung unserer Arbeitgebermarke für junge Talente mit, z. B. Out-of-Home-Kampagnen oder Podcasts
  • Lebenslanges Lernen: Du arbeitest eng mit verschiedenen Schnittstellen wie Talent Attraction, Student Attraction, University Relations und Talent Programs zusammen und erhältst dadurch Einblicke in unterschiedliche Bereiche
  • Du bist nah an unseren Talenten: An verschiedenen Talent Touchpoints bist du eine wichtige Anlaufstelle für unsere Talente. Ob über unsere Career Inbox oder Arbeitgeberplattformen, du beantwortest Fragen, hilfst bei Anliegen weiter und gestaltest so eine positive Candidate Experience vom ersten Kontakt an aktiv mit
  • Erweitere deinen Horizont: Du erhältst die Möglichkeit, weitere Themen wie z.B. Diversity-Initiativen kennenzulernen und dich in einem internationalen und inklusiven Arbeitsumfeld einzubringen, indem Teamwork und Chancengleichheit großgeschrieben werden

Dein Profil
Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten, die dir zum Erfolg verhelfen


  • Studienfach: Du studierst derzeit Kommunikationswissenschaften, Wirtschaftspsychologie, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder ein ähnliches Fach
  • Berufserfahrung: Du hast idealerweise bereits praktische Erfahrungen durch ein Praktikum oder eine Werkstudierendentätigkeit gesammelt
  • Arbeitsweise: Du zeichnest dich durch ein stilsicheres Auftreten,einen kreativen Schreibstil und sehr gute Grammatikkenntnisse aus
  • Persönlichkeit: Du arbeitest gerne selbstständig, bist zuverlässig und strukturiert. Außerdem scheust du dich nicht, deine eigenen Ideen proaktiv einzubringen und selbstständig umzusetzen
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Du verfügst über sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse, sowohl in Wort als auch in Schrift
  • Verfügbarkeit: Du bist ab 14.02.2027 (alternativ ab 01.03.2027) für sechs Monate verfügbar

Bitte liefere uns folgende Unterlagen in Deiner Bewerbung mit:

  • Lebenslauf
  • Immatrikulationsbescheinigung
  • Aktuelle Notenübersicht (nicht älter als 6 Monate)
  • Schulabschlusszeugnis
  • ggf. Pflichtpraktikumbescheinigung


Weiterführende Links:

  • Finde heraus, was uns an Deinem Lebenslauf wichtig ist
  • Finde heraus, wie der studentische Bewerbungsprozess bei uns abläuft
  • Entdecke unsere Studierenden-Webseite

title: Internship - AI, Digitalization & Software Development in Product Marketing (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Initiatives: Support Artificial Intelligence (AI) and digitalization initiatives within Product Marketing and help foster an AI-oriented and digital mindset across the team
  • Solutions: Develop and prototype AI-based applications, agents, automations and software solutions, translating Product Marketing requirements and ideas into practical technical solutions
  • Process Improvement: Identify Product Marketing processes that can be simplified, automated or improved through AI and evaluate new AI technologies for their potential applications in Product Marketing
  • Development Practices: Apply agentic coding approaches and AI-supported development tools such as GitHub Copilot and work with modern software development practices, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines
  • Integration: Support the integration of different data sources, tools and systems
  • Delivery: Support the development, testing and deployment of solutions


Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min. 12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Currently studying Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Systems Engineering, Software Engineering or a comparable technical field
  • Technical Skills: Good understanding of software development and good knowledge of multiple programming languages
  • Interests: Strong interest in combining technology with business and Product Marketing applications, as well as in Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI and agentic AI
  • Practical Experience: Ideally, first experience with AI-supported coding tools such as GitHub Copilot; a basic understanding of software deployment and CI/CD pipelines is an advantage
  • Working Style: Hands-on, curious, and AI-oriented approach; able to understand business problems and translate them into technical solutions; independent and structured working style
  • Availability: Ideally interested in staying with the team alongside their studies until graduation
  • Language Skills: Good English skills

Additional information

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Lisa Derhaschnig

title: Internship - Strategy Projects (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


 Are you in?


Your role

Do you want to help us drive this transformation and shape the strategy for a global high-tech company by becoming a full-fledged member of our Strategy Projects team for 4-6 months?
Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Shape the future: You are actively participating in the execution of high impact strategic projects and take ownership of your own work-streams
  • Teamwork is dreamwork: You are part of a small, diverse team of high performing strategy project managers (50+% female)
  • Data is everything: You dive deep into complex data, understand the implications and visualize your findings concisely for communication towards senior business leaders 

Your profile

We’re looking for generalist profiles with work experience from internships/ working student positions at a renowned consulting company or in a corporate strategy environment; or Technology profiles with exceptional academic achievements and a strong interest in applying technology to business challenges
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 

  •  Study field: You successfully completed a Bachelor's degree at a renowned university with outstanding academic performance, ideally business administration or natural sciences
  • Motivation: You are self-driven, highly motivated and have a keen interest in both technology and business strategy
  • Skills: You can handle complex data sets in Excel and visualize/present in Power Point with confidence, AI related skills are a bonus
  • Language skills: You are fluent in English, both written and spoken


Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

Important information:

  • Proper students (according to the German law) are welcome: To work as a student employee with us, you must be enrolled at a university and not have completed all of your exams or modules for your degree programme. You must not be in a semester of leave. We look forward to welcoming you to our team for 4 to 6 months.
  •  You should live close to the site: For good collaboration, it is important to us that you can come to the office regularly to integrate into the team.

title: Internship - High Speed and RF LAB Validation Engineer in Development Center Villach (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role
We are looking for students with the willingness to work in a challenging environment within a highly motivated international team. This specific job is suitable for students within technical studies in the field of electronic engineering.
We are offering students the possibility to be a part of the chip design process by supporting the validation of new semiconductor solutions.
Key responsibilities in your new role
  • Mixed-Signal and RF Exposure: Gain experience with Mixed-Signal High-Speed, RF, mmWave, and Integrated Circuits
  • High-Speed and RF Measurements: Develop expertise in measurements related to High-Speed PLLs, Data Communication (Jitter, Eye Diagrams, BERT), and work with advanced RF/mmWave equipment
  • Data Processing Applications: Acquire knowledge in data processing for digital communication and radar applications
  • Practical Validation Experience: Gain hands-on experience in validation and debugging processes
  • PCB Design and Prototyping: Contribute to the design of PCBs for product measurements and evaluate new tools and methodologies
  • Comprehensive Validation Flow: Familiarize yourself with validation processes, defining measurement setups, automation, data post-processing, and analysis

Further information:
Type of employment: Temporary / part-time or full-time (Flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 12 months
Bachelor or Master Thesis topics are available if requested.



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed
  • Educational Background: Pursuing a degree in Electronic Engineering, Microelectronics, or a related field
  • Mathematical and Circuit Analysis Skills: Strong foundation in mathematical concepts, circuit analysis, FFT, algorithms, or digital filtering
  • Programming and Software Knowledge: Proficiency in Matlab and strong programming skills
  • Measurement Tools Proficiency: Familiarity with instruments such as Oscilloscopes, Signal Spectrum Analyzers, and Vector Network Analyzers
  • Understanding of Electronic Circuits: Basic knowledge of Oscillators, PLLs, Transceivers, RF or mmWave Blocks, and RADAR hardware
  • Interest in Data Processing: Demonstrated interest or potential experience in data processing for digital communication and radar applications
  • Language and Work Style: Good English skills and a structured, precise working approach

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (English) to your application:
  • CV
  • Motivation letter
  • Certificate of matriculation at a university
  • Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)
  • Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)
  • Reference letter (optional)



Contact:
    Sabrina Nindler

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. We base our recruiting decisions on the applicant´s experience and skills. Learn more about our various contact channels.
We look forward to receiving your resume, even if you do not entirely meet all the requirements of the job posting.
Please let your recruiter know if they need to pay special attention to something in order to enable your participation in the interview process.
Click here for more information about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Industriepraktikum - Global Procurement Facility Management (w/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Bereit Deinen nächsten Karriereschritt zu gehen?
Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln. Egal ob Praktikum, Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder als Trainee - bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei.
Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten


  • Einkaufsteam: Unterstützung des globalen Facility-Management-Einkaufsteams in den täglichen Beschaffungsaktivitäten
  • Preisanalysen: Erstellung von Preisvergleichen und Analyse von Angeboten zur Ableitung klarer Empfehlungen
  • Lieferantenbetreuung: Unterstützung bei Lieferantenbewertungen sowie beim Lieferantenaufbau zur Stärkung des Portfolios
  • Stakeholder: Koordination mit internen und externen Stakeholdern zur Sicherstellung abgestimmter Entscheidungen
  • Präsentationen: Vorbereitung von Präsentationen und Unterlagen für Meetings und Reviews
  • Effizienz: Optimierung von Prozessen im Einkauf mithilfe von Künstlicher Intelligenz (KI) zur Steigerung der Effizienz


Weitere Informationen:

Beschäftigungsart: Befristet / Teilzeit (Flexible Arbeitszeit von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 06:00 und 19:00 Uhr)

  • Validation: Support application engineers with testing and validation of low voltage metal-oxide-semiconductor field-effect transistors (MOSFETs)
  • Automation: Build automated test setups to streamline measurements
  • Board Design: Create printed circuit boards (PCBs) using Altium
  • Documentation: Create measurement reports and record debugging setups
  • Debugging: Assist with troubleshooting during validation and test execution
  • Lab Support: Help with daily tasks including soldering components and maintaining laboratory equipment


Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time or Full-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

  • Tools: Good skills with MATLAB, Altium, Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis (SPICE) and Piecewise Linear Electrical Circuit Simulation (PLECS)
  • Soft Skills: Motivation, commitment and good communication
  • Language Skills: Good English skills

Additional information

title: Internship -  Electroacoustic Measurement Laboratory (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Acoustics: Conduct independent electroacoustic measurements on innovative components based on application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), in an anechoic room or special measurement boxes
  • Lab Equipment: Use professional laboratory measurement equipment, including equipment from Audio Precision, oscilloscopes, signal generators, and spectrum analyzers
  • Audio Validation: Validate key audio specifications, including signal-to-noise ratio (SNR), total harmonic distortion (THD), and frequency responses
  • Automation: Support more efficient measurement workflows using MATLAB or Python
  • Data Preparation: Accurately record measurement results and prepare them for the development team


Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time / Full-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min. 6 months



Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: You are a motivated and committed student in electrical engineering, information technology, physics, media technology, acoustics or a related field.
  • Technical Skills: Initial exposure to analog and digital circuit technology, including application-specific integrated circuits (ASICs), and a basic understanding of acoustics and signal processing
  • Practical Experience: Ideally, some initial laboratory experience and programming skills, for example in Python or MATLAB
  • Working Style: Structured and detail-oriented approach, with an enjoyment of experimenting
  • Language Skills: Good English skills, German skills are an advantage

Additional information

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

description_html:

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Analysis: Perform incoming and outgoing inspection of parts after cleaning process and also special analyses/experiments on samples/parts to optimize cleaning processes
  • Instrumentation: Various types of cleaners (FOUP, Vertical Quartz, Stainless Steel etc.), Sand Blasting, Roughness, Air Molecular Contamination (AMC) and other laboratory instruments and methods

title: Internship - Data and Workflows for AI Usage in Unit Process Development (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.


 Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Lifelong learning: Acquire knowledge on plasma etching processing, AI-data readiness and development workflows

  • Data is everything: Access and analyze current databases, identify data gaps and develop a cloud database for missing recipe/measurement data

  • Shape the future: Develop a scalable OutSystems web application to document experiments, extending the capabilities of the existing documentation

  • Take responsibility: Develop and test automated workflows and digital solutions in the context of Unit Process Development

  • Focus on the future: Create and enhance internal tools, applications, and digital solutions using technologies such as C# or Python to collect, cleanse, and analyze measurement data

  • Convince with words: Document your methods, implementation, benchmark results, and limitations, and present your ideas


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study field: You are a top-performing student currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Computer Science, Data Science, or Artificial Intelligence

  • Skills: 

    • You have proven (2+ years) experience in programming, with practical knowledge of machine learning frameworks and data analysis tools

    • Familiarity with software development, scripting, and database technologies

    • Experience working with data pipelines, and data integration concepts is advantageous

  • Interests: You have a strong ambition for computer systems, programming and machine learning

  • Experience: 

    • You are experienced in programming and data analysis, with a strong foundation in statistics and mathematics

    • You are capable of critically assessing your own results

    • Experience in machine learning is a bonus

  • Personality: Proactive, self-driven and science interested. You have very good communication skills, capable of explaining complex concepts to non-expert and can organize your work in a very structured way

  • Language skills: You have fluent English skills, both written and spoken, German would be a plus

 

Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Excerpt of the study regulations for the mandatory internship (if applicable)
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Lara Praust

title: Internship - Embedded Memory Characterization (f/m/div)

#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Hardware & software setup: You will set up hardware and software for an embedded memory characterization bench

  • Program development: You will drive the creation of a characterization program for embedded memories 

  •  Device testing: You perform measurements of memories embedded within microcontroller devices

  •  Performance analysis: You will be responsible for systematic studies of the performance and interactions of the read and write operations

  •  Statistical analysis: You will ensure the development of analysis routines for evaluation of characterization results


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study field: You are currently studying electrical engineering, information or communication technology or similar

  • Skills: You possess good programming skills (Python, etc.) 

  • Experience: You are able to demonstrate knowledge in the field of electrical measurements and measurement automation 

  • Expertise: You bring expertise in mixed-signal design and characterization of semiconductor devices

  • Interests: You already gained knowledge about memory devices

  • Language skills: You are able to communicate in English fluently 

Please attach the following documents to your application:

  •  CV in English
  •  Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Excerpt of the study regulations for the mandatory internship (if applicable)

title: Industriepraktikum - Lab Logistic Support (w/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Was ist Dein nächster Move?
Werde Teil von etwas Echtem - mit echten Projekten, echtem Impact und echten Chancen, Dich weiterzuentwickeln. Egal ob Praktikum, Werkstudierendentätigkeit oder als Trainee - bei uns bist Du mittendrin statt nur dabei.
Are you in?


Deine Rolle
Haupttätigkeiten


  • Logistik: Annahme und Versand von Qualifikationsware sowie Verwaltung der zugehörigen Dokumentation
  • Auftragsbearbeitung: Erstellung und Nachverfolgung von Aufträgen mit laborspezifischer Software
  • Koordination: Durchführung von Planungsaktivitäten
  • Berichterstattung: Erstellung von Reports nach speziellen Kundenanforderungen
  • Qualifikation: Pflege von Datenbanken für die Produktqualifikation

Weitere Informationen:

Beschäftigungsart: Befristet / Teilzeit (Flexible Arbeitszeit von Montag bis Freitag zwischen 06:00 und 19:00 Uhr)

Dauer: min. 12 Monate


Dein Profil
Qualifikationen und Fähigkeiten, die dir zum Erfolg verhelfen


  • Ausbildung: Bachelor- oder Masterstudium in Betriebswirtschaftslehre, Management, Wirtschaftswissenschaften oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang
  • Technische Kenntnisse: Ausgezeichnete Kenntnisse in Microsoft Office und gutes allgemeines Wissen im Bereich Informationstechnologie
  • Erfahrung: Berufserfahrung durch Praktika ist von Vorteil
  • Persönliche Kompetenzen: Team- und Kommunikationsfähigkeit, Flexibilität, Lernfähigkeit und Belastbarkeit in Stresssituationen
  • Sprachkenntnisse: Gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse

Zusatzinformation


Diese Position unterliegt dem Kollektivvertrag für Arbeiter und Angestellte der Elektro- und Elektronikindustrie (Vollzeitbasis), Beschäftigungsgruppe B für Bachelorstudent*innen oder Beschäftigungsgruppe D für Masterstudent*innen (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization. Are you in?
Als ein weltweit führender Anbieter von Halbleiterlösungen für Power-Systeme und IoT ermöglichen wir wegweisende Lösungen für grüne und effiziente Energie, saubere und sichere Mobilität sowie ein intelligentes und sicheres IoT. Gemeinsam treiben wir Innovation und den Erfolg unserer Kund*innen voran. Gleichzeitig kümmern wir uns um unsere Mitarbeitenden und bestärken sie darin, ihre ambitionierten Ziele zu erreichen. Hilf uns, das Leben einfacher, sicherer und nachhaltiger zu machen.

 
Unser Ziel ist es, das beste Infineon für alle zu erschaffen.
Wir möchten durch Vielfalt und Inklusion das beste Infineon für alle erschaffen. Wir schätzen Bewerbende so, wie sie sind, und bieten ein Arbeitsumfeld, das auf Vertrauen, Offenheit, Respekt und Chancengleichheit basiert. 

Unsere Einstellungsentscheidungen basieren auf Fähigkeiten und Erfahrung. Auch wenn Du nicht alle Anforderungen erfüllst, ermutigen wir Dich, dich zu bewerben.

Bitte teile uns mit, falls Du während des Bewerbungsprozesses besondere Vorkehrungen benötigst.

Erfahre mehr über unsere verschiedenen Kontaktmöglichkeiten und über Diversity & Inclusion bei Infineon.


Ina Miklau

title: Internship - Power Electronics System
description_html:
The student, as part of the Power Electronics System Application Engineering team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will undertake projects working on Infineon's power semiconductors, reference designs and test systems.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Lab Testing: Test power semiconductor devices, evaluation boards, and systems in a laboratory environment.
  • Prototype Construction: Build and assemble prototypes for experimental evaluation and validation.
  • Simulation: Utilize various simulation tools to model and compare outcomes with experimental results.
  • Data Analysis: Analyze and interpret results obtained from experiments and simulations.

Internship Learning Outcome:

  • Laboratory Techniques: Gain hands-on experience in laboratory testing techniques for power semiconductors and power electronics.
  • Simulation Tools: Develop proficiency in using industry-relevant simulation tools and software.
  • Data Analysis: Build skills in analyzing and interpreting experimental and simulation data.
  • Research Methodology: Acquire foundational knowledge and practice in structured research methodologies.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Currently on track to attain a Bachelor's degree in Electrical & Electronic Engineering.
  • Hands-On Aptitude: Comfortable and experienced working hands-on with equipment and tools.
  • Attention to Detail: Demonstrates strong attention to detail with the ability to work accurately and precisely.
  • Research Mindset: Possesses a research-oriented mindset with curiosity and drive to explore technical challenges.



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. description_html:
Your International Graduate Program

·   Start and build your Product Management experience in Shenzhen, close to the Chinese customer and market ecosystem.

·  Complete an international assignment in Europe to learn the global product-line organization, manufacturing and cross-functional interfaces and to build your international network.

·  Work on meaningful projects from day one while receiving mentoring, professional guidance and tailored development opportunities.

·  Return to China with the target of continuing your career in Product Management.



Your role

  • Join Infineon’s International Graduate Program (IGP) in Shenzhen and start your career in Product Management for high-power semiconductors. You will work with a portfolio of discrete IGBTs and high-voltage SiC discretes, gaining hands-on experience in the daily commercial and operational management of semiconductor products and their business in China.

    The program combines assignments in China with an international assignment in Europe. After completing the IGP, the target position is in Product Management in China.

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Support the day-to-day management of a discrete IGBT and high-voltage SiC product portfolio, working closely with experienced Product Managers.

  • Coordinate product availability and supply topics with Sales, Operations, Supply Chain and manufacturing teams, and support prioritization and allocation decisions when required.

  • Maintain and analyze product, customer and business data such as forecasts, orders, revenue, pricing, inventory, design wins and product demand.

  • Support pricing and quotation activities, including preparation of pricing information and coordination with regional Sales and global business teams.

  • Act as a product interface for the China organization and help Sales, FAEs and customers resolve commercial and product-related questions.

  • Support new product introductions and customer ramp-ups, coordinating samples, qualification status, product documentation and readiness across the relevant functions.

  • Monitor the competitive situation for discrete IGBTs and high-voltage SiC and prepare concise product and business analyses for the team.

  • Take ownership of selected Product Management projects and continuously improve tools, processes and transparency for managing the portfolio.


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • A recent Master’s graduate in Electrical Engineering, Power Electronics, Semiconductor Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Business Engineering or a related field.

  • First practical experience through internships, university projects or working-student roles in semiconductors, power electronics, operations, sales/marketing or product-related functions is an advantage.

  • Interest in power semiconductors and the commercial and operational side of Product Management; knowledge of IGBT or SiC technology is a plus, not a prerequisite.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with data, combined with a structured and pragmatic working style.

  • Good communication and coordination skills and the motivation to work with cross-functional and international teams.

  • Fluent Mandarin and strong written and spoken English.

  • Willingness to spend part of the IGP on an international assignment in Europe and then continue in the target position in China.


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


sunny.wang@infineon.cn

title: Internship - Embedded Systems Engineering
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together!

Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


As an Embedded Systems Engineering intern (6 months), you will gain hands-on experience in embedded systems by supporting customers in applying microcontroller and connectivity solutions to their designs. Working alongside experienced engineers, you will develop practical hardware and software skills while learning how engineering teams support customer projects from design and development through preparation for production.


This internship provides an opportunity to be considered for a full-time position upon successful completion of the internship. Full-time conversion will be based on individual performance, business needs, and position availability.


  • Customer Application Support: Support customer design-in activities involving microcontrollers, security microcontrollers, and connectivity solutions

  • Hardware and Software Support: Assist with technical questions, testing, troubleshooting, and debugging under the guidance of experienced engineers

  • Design and Development Support: Assist with customer projects across design, development, and preparation for production

  • Technical Problem Solving: Investigate technical issues and collaborate with internal and external technical resources to identify potential solutions

  • Customer Engagement: Support technical discussions, demonstrations, and training activities for customers

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work with regional and global engineering teams to share customer feedback and address technical topics

  • Technical Learning: Build practical knowledge of embedded systems, microcontrollers, and related hardware and software technologies


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed a Bachelor's degree or above in Electrical Engineering, Electronic Engineering, Computer Engineering, Computer Science, or a related field

  • Programming Knowledge: Basic understanding of C programming or other relevant programming languages

  • Embedded Systems Knowledge: Basic understanding of embedded programming, microcontrollers, or processor architectures such as Arm

  • Technical Foundation: Familiarity with embedded operating systems, drivers, or hardware and software interfaces is preferred

  • Problem Solving: Strong interest in analyzing technical problems and learning how to troubleshoot hardware and software issues

  • Debugging Skills: Experience with software, hardware, or system-level debugging through coursework, projects, or other practical activities is preferred

  • Working Style: Curious, proactive, collaborative, and willing to learn through hands-on technical challenges


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Suzy Choi

title: International Graduate Program – System Application Engineer for AI Power
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. We are in the rapid changing semiconductor industry driven by AI. From creating tiny chips to developing intelligent AI server power delivery system, ambition makes the difference for an engineering talent.

 

Join Infineon’s International Graduate Program (IGP) and fast-track your development in just 18 months. You’ll rotate through three assignments in different departments, including one abroad, gaining hands-on experience, global exposure, and a deep understanding of our business. From day one, you’re a permanent employee working on meaningful projects, growing your network, and discovering where you can shine.

 

As part of Infineon's International Graduate Program, you'll rotate through impactful roles, collaborate with global teams, and develop the skills to shape the Infineon of tomorrow. Start your journey to a career where your ambition meets endless possibilities.

 

As a System Application Engineer IGP, you will focus on the optimal design of efficient, intelligent, reliable system power delivery solutions for DC powered AI server IT rack. This position is a part of dedicated engineering talent development program with 3 assignments in US and Asia region.

 


Are you ready for the challenge? 


As a System Application Engineer IGP, you will focus on the optimal design of efficient, intelligent, reliable system power delivery solutions for DC powered AI server IT rack. This position is a part of dedicated engineering talent development program with 3 assignments in US and Asia region.

 

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Assignment 1 (Duration: 6 months; location: San Jose, CA, USA): Optimal design of High efficiency 800V to 50V/12V/6V DC/DC power solutions for future AI servers. Detail work include design analysis, simulation and testing of HV intermediate bus converters
  •  Assignment 2 (Duration: 6 months; location: EL Segundo, CA, USA): Solution implementation of comprehensive hot swap solutions with fault tolerance and black box features for reliable power delivery of IT rack. Detail work include the design, validation and documentation of Intelligent hotswap demos with built-in black box features.
  • Assignment 3 (Duration: 6 month; Location: Taipei, Taiwan): Deep-dive study of system integration of power delivery building blocks and Dynamic power management of DC powered IT rack. Detail work include power tree analysis, power redundance analysis, system level power management analysis. Engineering work in our Taipei office and technical support to ODMs with US OEMs will included in this assignment.
  • Final Placement: Upon the completion of International assignments, the position will be converted to a full-time employee in Infineon’s silicon valley headquarters in San Jose, CA




You are curious across many topics and proactively seek opportunities rather than waiting; you thrive on change and apply pragmatic, analytical thinking instead of standing still. You draw energy from teamwork, collaborate on the big picture, and confidently lead to drive results with your expertise.


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Recent Graduate (0-1 years) with a Masters or Ph.D. in Electrical Engineering with focus on power electronics preferred
  • Power Experience: Solid foundation in design, modeling, and validation of power converters for data center and telecom applications
  • Control Skills: Hands-on experience with closed-loop control of power converters using digital controllers and real-time platforms
  • Soft Skills: Thrives in agile environments with strong collaboration, communication, and adaptability
  • Language: Fluent written and spoken English
  • US citizen or green card holder: This position requires a valid U.S. passport and the ability to travel and work internationally

Additional information

Infineon Technologies is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.


Employment at Infineon is contingent upon proof of your legal right to work in the United States under applicable law, verification of satisfactory references, successful completion of a background check and drug test, and signing all your on-boarding documents.


In some instances, if applicable, U.S. export control laws require that Infineon obtain a U.S. government export license prior to releasing technologies to certain persons. This offer is contingent upon Infineon's ability to satisfy these export control laws as related to your employment and anticipated job activities. The decision whether or not to submit and/or pursue an export license to satisfy this contingency, if applicable, shall be at Infineon's sole discretion.


Infineon Technologies takes data privacy and identity theft very seriously. As such, we do not request personally-identifiable information (PII) from applicants over the internet or electronically. Please kindly refrain from disclosing your PII electronically during the application process or to unauthorized websites that may purport to be Infineon or any of our affiliates.



Salary pay information:

LocationIndicative salary range
San Jose, CA United StatesWage range that the company expects to pay for a qualified candidate:
US$ 120,000 – US$ 150,000

Hourly rate will depend on the highest level of education completed.

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Selena Gutierrez

title: Talent Acquisition Trainee (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. 

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. 

Are you in?



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


In this professional internship opportunity, with a fixed-term contract of 12 months, you will:


  • Team support: Provide overall support to Recruiters with daily talent attraction activities
  • Job posting: Create and post attractive job advertisements for different European countries and several job families
  • Candidate evaluation: Perform the candidate preselection in the Applicant Tracking System, based on the information from the Hiring Manager
  • Candidate pre-screening: Conduct phone assessments to gather relevant information from the candidates
  • Active sourcing: Develop and implement sourcing strategies, making use of our internal database and LinkedIn Recruiter
  • Material development: Create different reports and presentations that support Talent Attraction activities

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Degree in Psychology, Human Resources, Business, Management or an equivalent field
  • Interests: Interest in Talent Acquisition topics and in connecting with people
  • Tools: A good command of Microsoft Office (especially Excel and PowerPoint), and confidence in using digital tools
  • Working style: Good communication skills and a collaborative mindset; Proactive personality with a sense of urgency and attention to detail at all times
  • Language skills: Fluency in English (mandatory)


Please send us your CV in English so we can get to know you better!

title: Internship - Quality Management System
description_html:
The student will be part of the Quality Management System (QMS) team and work under the guidance of an assigned mentor. The student will support the team in daily operations, improvement initiatives, and short-term assignments related to QMS activities. As an active team member, the student is expected to contribute to enhancing the efficiency and effectiveness of the QMS while gaining practical knowledge and experience in quality management processes.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • AI & Analytics Development: Develop and maintain data analytics tools utilizing AI to enable efficient analysis, visualization, and reporting of quality-related information.
  • Departmental Support: Assist in organizing and supporting Quality Management (QM) department events and administrative activities.
  • Digitalization & AI Initiatives: Support division-wide digitalization and AI initiatives, including data management, automation projects, and performance reporting.
  • Continuous Process Improvement: Participate in continuous improvement projects to enhance Quality Management System (QMS) processes, reporting efficiency, and overall operational effectiveness.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Quality Business Processes: Gain a practical understanding of quality business processes, tools, and methodologies, and apply them in a real-world manufacturing environment.
  • Digitalization & Efficiency: Acquire hands-on knowledge of AI and digitalization concepts, learning how to apply them to improve daily work efficiency.
  • Project Management Skills: Develop foundational project management skills by actively participating in project planning, execution, monitoring, and review phases.
  • Factory QMS Structure: Learn the systematic workflows and standards of a Quality Management System (QMS) within a semiconductor manufacturing factory.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Industrial & Systems Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Productivity & AI Tools: Proficient in MS Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint) and familiar with consumer AI tools.
  • Work Ethic & Collaboration: Strong ability to collaborate effectively within a team environment, while remaining self-motivated and capable of working under minimal supervision.
  • Preferred Skills: Additional skills in data analytics, software coding, AI Copilot integration, or event organization are highly advantageous.
  • Communication Skills: Good written and verbal communication skills, with a strong capability for technical and status reporting.
  • Preferred Intake: Jan 27 – May/June 27



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

title: Internship - Development of a flexible robot hardware system architecture (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. 


The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. 


Are you in?



Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


As part of our team, you will explore state-of-the-art robotic architectures and support the development of flexible embedded hardware platforms. You will play an active role in implementing new functionalities and driving innovation in robotic systems.


  • Experience research: You will do literature research on existing solutions and state-of-the-art hardware system architectures of robots
  • Take responsibility: You build a flexible hardware platform for robot applications based on several MCUs and sensors and develop the corresponding C code
  • Shape the future: You will work on the development of new features and functions that optionally include AI/ML techniques
  • Identify needs: You create concise test reports, document code and present results as well as suggestions for improving the system architecture

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study field: You are currently studying electrical/computer engineering, computer science or similar
  • Experience: You have a background in embedded systems and have gained experience in programming microcontrollers and working with their peripherals. You also bring experience in FPGA development and ideally have initial experience with modeling and simulation tools
  • Skills: You have a solid understanding of digital design and computer architecture fundamentals, along with advanced proficiency in C programming. You are confident in working with microcontrollers or comparable DSPs and ideally bring a basic understanding of AI/ML techniques


Please attach the following documents to your application:

  • CV in English
  • Certificate of enrollment at university
  • Excerpt of the study regulations for the mandatory internship (if applicable)
  • Latest grades transcript (not older than 6 months)
  • High school report


Further links:

·         Find out what we are looking for in your CV

·         Find out how the student application process works with us

·         Discover our student website



Kerstin Semmler


#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Internship - Chip Verification
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Execute SoC verification tasks and work closely with team members to review and understand the relevant functional and safety related requirements
  • Work and align with different stakeholders to identify verification plans and define SOC verification strategies
  • Execute the verification plan by developing C/C++ testcases and System Verilog/UVM testbench components and by integrating 3rd party VIP components


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Student of Electronics major
  • Knowledge of electronic devices and circuits, digital integrated circuits, computer architecture
  • Knowledge of hardware description language (Verilog/VDHL), hardware (functional) simulation
  • Basic knowledge about C and C++
  • Able to read English documents(Nice-to-have) Knowledge or experience on hardware verification language (System Verilog) and methodology (UVM)
  • (Nice-to-have) Hands-on experience with hardware simulation tools and scripting
  • (Nice-to-have) Experience with working on Unix/Linux environment
  • (Nice-to-have) Hands-on experience with FPGA
  • (Nice-to-have) Experience working in university labs on IC design topics

title: Internship - Electro‑Acoustics and Signal Processing (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?


Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Expert Collaboration: Work with experts at a global semiconductor company and leading MEMS microphone supplier to develop and characterize next-generation audio technologies
  • Electro-Acoustic Support: Support the team with a strong focus on electro-acoustic lab work and early-stage concept development
  • Product Insights: Gain insights into the development of MEMS audio products for smartphones, hearables, IoT and automotive applications
  • Performance Analysis: Measure and analyze performance parameters as well as audio quality of existing and next-generation microphones
  • Novel Concepts: Work on novel sensing concepts, experiment design, fixture preparation, data processing and visualization (e.g., Python, MATLAB) and listening tests
  • Innovation Contribution: Help shape the next generation of microphone solutions

Further Information
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 12 months


Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Motivated and committed master student (f/m/div) from the field of Electronics or Electrical Engineering with focus on Audio Engineering or similar
  • Knowledge: Background in acoustics and signal processing
  • Lab Skills: Hands-on experience in laboratory environments
  • Curiosity: Curiosity for state-of-the-art developments of microphone solutions in the semiconductor industry
  • Language Skills: Good English skills

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:
  • Motivation letter
  • CV
  • Certificate of matriculation at a university
  • Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)
  • Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)
  • Reference letter (optional)




Contact:
    Ina Miklau

title: Internship – Regional Distribution Centre Logistics Management
description_html:
The student as part of Regional Distribution Centre Team will be working with various stakeholders including our outsourced 3PL warehouse team to facilitate daily operations, covering full set of warehouse activities and monitoring via Infineon Systems (i.e. ERP SAP, PIF SAP, Assist4, PIO SAP). The student will also have a chance to involve in projects that are related to digitalization.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Customer Experience & Improvement: Support continuous improvement projects designed to address customer concerns and enhance service quality.
  • Operational Excellence: Identify, evaluate, and manage potential improvements in daily operations to drive efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Digital Transformation: Actively contribute to logistics and warehouse digitalization initiatives, including process automation and system integration.
  • Daily Operations & Reporting: Support day-to-day operational tasks and ensure the accuracy and timely delivery of daily performance reports.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Supply Chain Mastery: Gain a comprehensive understanding of the Infineon Supply Chain concept and the full scope of logistics warehouse operations.
  • Digital Innovation: Obtain hands-on exposure to digitalization projects and emerging technologies within the logistics landscape.
  • Global Market Insight: Develop a deep understanding of the distinct business environments and market dynamics in Asia Pacific and Europe.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Enhance communication skills and learn to effectively collaborate with diverse internal and external stakeholders.
  • Technical Proficiency: Acquire practical knowledge and operational skills in SAP systems.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Educational Background: Hold a Bachelor’s, or Master’s degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related field. 
  • Technical Exposure: Academic exposure to Python, Tableau, or other programming languages is considered a strong plus, though not mandatory. 
  • Personal Attributes: Demonstrate keen learning agility, self-motivation, and strong teamwork skills, with the ability to multitask across projects and priorities while maintaining effective communication and interpersonal relationships.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: Possess strong analytical capabilities and a proactive, meticulous approach to identifying improvement opportunities through data analysis. 
  • Availability & Duration: Available for an internship starting in January 2027 onwards, for a duration of 6 to 12 months.



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin



#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. We base our recruiting decisions on the applicant´s experience and skills. Learn more about our various contact channels.
Please let your recruiter know if they need to pay special attention to something in order to enable your participation in the interview process.
Click here for more information about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Internship - Applications Engineer
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step of your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • System Validation: Validate power stage and control designs on application boards
  • Characterization Support: Characterize multiphase power management ICs following Intel and AMD VR specifications
  • Chipset Testing: Verify new chipsets and voltage regulator solutions for customer applications
  • Evaluation Boards Development: Develop and test customer application evaluation boards for accurate system functionality
  • Hardware Support: Build additional hardware setups such as efficiency measurement wind tunnels and stress testers for evaluations
  • Report Compilation: Prepare analytical reports based on validation and characterization data


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Actively pursuing a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree program in Electrical or Electronic Engineering or related field
  • Semiconductor Background: Knowledge of switching power supply topologies and VR solutions preferred
  • Hands-On Experience: Proficiency in SMT soldering and using lab equipment like oscilloscopes, DMMs, and network analyzers
  • Software Skills: Familiarity with schematic capture and PCB layout tools like Altium or OrCAD
  • Analytical Abilities: Strong skills in data organization and reporting using Microsoft Office tools
  • Technical Knowledge: Thorough understanding of passive and active components and experience with analog/digital circuits
  • Soft Skills: Attention to detail, strong problem-solving ability, and collaborative work ethic
    • Find out what we are looking for in your CV
    • Find out how the student application process works with us
    • Discover our student website

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.
This means we embrace diversity and inclusion and welcome everyone for who they are. At Infineon, we offer a working environment characterized by trust, openness, respect and tolerance and are committed to give all applicants and employees equal opportunities. Click here for more information about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

Driving decarbonization and digitalization. Together.

Infineon Technologies Americas Corp., is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), gender identity, national origin, ancestry, citizenship, age, physical or mental disability, legally protected medical condition, family care status, military or veteran status, marital status, domestic partner status, sexual orientation, or any other basis protected by local, state, or federal laws.

Employment at Infineon is contingent upon proof of your legal right to work in the United States under applicable law, verification of satisfactory references and successful completion of a background check and drug test, and signing all your on-boarding documents.

In some instances, if applicable, U.S. export control laws require that Infineon obtain a U.S. government export license prior to releasing technologies to certain persons. This offer is contingent upon Infineon's ability to satisfy these export control laws as related to your employment and anticipated job activities. The decision whether or not to submit and/or pursue an export license to satisfy this contingency, if applicable, shall be at Infineon's sole discretion.

Infineon Technologies takes data privacy and identity theft very seriously. As such, we do not request personally-identifiable information (PII) from applicants over the internet or electronically. Please kindly refrain from disclosing your PII electronically during the application process or to unauthorized websites that may purport to be Infineon or any of our affiliates.

Wage range that the company expects to pay for a qualified candidate:

Minimum of $20.00per hour
Maximum of $36.50 per hour

Hourly rate will depend on the highest level of education completed.

title: Internship - Analog Mixed-Signal Design
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step of your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Analog and Mixed-Signal IC Design: Contribute to the design, simulation, and verification of analog and mixed-signal integrated circuits
  • Operational Amplifier Design: Apply operational amplifier theory, perform stability analysis, and implement compensation techniques for enhanced circuit performance
  • Low Power Circuit Design: Design low-power circuits, such as LDOs and Buck converters, to optimize energy efficiency and performance
  • Silicon Characterization and Debug: Verify silicon performance against specifications through lab characterization and debugging processes
  • Scripting and Workflow Automation: Use and apply scripting languages like Python, Perl, TCL, or Shell to automate design workflows and data analysis tasks
  • Team Collaboration: Actively participate in team activities, including design reviews and brainstorming sessions, ensuring the sharing of ideas and alignment with project goals


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Currently enrolled in an M.S. program in Electrical Engineering or a related field
  • Technical Expertise: Proficiency in analog IC design, operational amplifier theory, and low-power design principles
  • Programming Skills: Familiarity with and ability to use scripting languages (Python, Perl, TCL, Shell) and automation tools
  • Personality Traits: Eager to learn, adaptable to changing challenges, team-oriented, and equipped with strong communication skills

  • Discover our student website
