description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Trade your textbooks for tools to innovate. Let’s shape your next step together. Whether through our Graduate Programs or your first full-time role, Infineon gives you the tools, trust, and challenges to grow fast and go far. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • EMC Testing: Conduct EMC measurements and analysis for automotive Ethernet products
  • Simulation: Perform signal integrity and power integrity simulations for high‑speed PCBs and packages
  • Modeling: Develop and maintain channel and device models (S‑parameters, IBIS‑AMI) for high‑speed interfaces
  • Correlation: Correlate simulations with measurements using VNA, TDR, and spectrum analyzers
  • Sign‑off: Review and drive SI/PI sign‑off for internal high‑speed PCB designs
  • Design: Define PCB and package stack‑ups, material selection, and design guidelines
  • Collaboration: Partner with IC design teams to define EMC specifications for new products


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Experience: 1+ year of work experience in high‑speed SI/PI and EMC‑related fields
  • Education: Major in high‑speed SI/PI, EMC, or a related discipline
  • Simulation: Experience with simulation tools such as Ansys HFSS and Keysight ADS
  • Instrumentation: Familiarity with lab equipment including VNA, TDR, and high‑speed oscilloscopes
  • Design: Experience in high‑speed digital system design, including PCB and package design
  • Theory: Strong understanding of electromagnetic theory, transmission lines, and antenna theory
  • Communication: Excellent communication skills and a strong team‑oriented mindset
  • Programming: Hands‑on proficiency with Python and MATLAB for automation and data analysis

title: Internship - Corporate Communications
description_html:
The student, as part of the Singapore Corporate Communications team and under the guidance of a supervisor, will support the team with the planning and execution of external and internal events, content development for various channels, and other communications tasks and projects as assigned.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role:


  • Administrative & Organizational Support: Manage day-to-day tasks including calendar coordination, meeting scheduling and notes, asset organization, and tracking approvals and deadlines
  • Communications Planning & Execution: Assist in the planning and execution of internal and external communications campaigns and events, coordinating logistics, timelines, and stakeholder outreach
  • Short-Form Video Production: Produce short-form video content for social and internal channels such as concept, shoot, perform basic editing, and add captions/graphics for distribution
  • Event & Announcement Photography: Capture and edit basic photography for events, announcements, and social media; prepare images for web and internal use
  • Content Drafting & Proofreading: Draft and proofread social posts, intranet articles, email copy, and simple press materials; adapt tone for different audiences
  • Digital Asset Management: Organize and maintain digital asset libraries and communication workflows to ensure easy retrieval and consistent version control
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Help track campaign and content performance metrics; compile simple reports to inform future content decisions
  • Collaboration & Team Support: Work with cross-functional teams to gather approvals, share assets, and maintain clear communication across projects
  • Ad-hoc Communications Projects: Take on other communications tasks and short-term projects as assigned to support team priorities

Internship Learning Outcomes

  • Practical Multimedia Experience: Hands-on experience producing multimedia content tailored for a corporate audience
  • Campaign & Event Coordination: How to plan, coordinate, and execute communications campaigns and internal/external events
  • End-to-End Video Workflow: Practical skills across concepting, shooting, editing, captioning, and distributing short-form video
  • Corporate Writing & Storytelling: Best practices for concise, audience-appropriate corporate writing and storytelling
  • Asset & Workflow Management: Techniques for managing digital asset libraries and optimizing team communication workflows.






Your Profile

You are best equipped for the task if you are/have:


  • Education & Background: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Media Production, or a related field
  • Organizational Strengths: Strong organizational and administrative skills; comfortable managing calendars, deadlines, and multiple priorities
  • Multimedia Skills: Experience creating basic video content and photography; familiarity with simple photo and video editing tools
  • Writing Proficiency: Clear, concise writing and proofreading skills with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences
  • Social Media Savvy: Familiarity with social platforms and best practices for short-form content formats
  • Collaboration Tools: Comfortable using collaboration and productivity tools (e.g., Webex, SharePoint); quick to learn new platforms
  • Portfolio: Portfolio or samples of prior video/photo/content work (student or personal projects acceptable)
  • Adaptability & Team Fit: Proactive, reliable, and able to take direction while contributing creative ideas
  • Preferred intake: Jan 27 - May/ June 27



Contact:

position_details_raw.jobDescription:
The student, as part of the Singapore Corporate Communications team and under the guidance of a supervisor, will support the team with the planning and execution of external and internal events, content development for various channels, and other communications tasks and projects as assigned.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role:


  • Administrative & Organizational Support: Manage day-to-day tasks including calendar coordination, meeting scheduling and notes, asset organization, and tracking approvals and deadlines
  • Communications Planning & Execution: Assist in the planning and execution of internal and external communications campaigns and events, coordinating logistics, timelines, and stakeholder outreach
  • Short-Form Video Production: Produce short-form video content for social and internal channels such as concept, shoot, perform basic editing, and add captions/graphics for distribution
  • Event & Announcement Photography: Capture and edit basic photography for events, announcements, and social media; prepare images for web and internal use
  • Content Drafting & Proofreading: Draft and proofread social posts, intranet articles, email copy, and simple press materials; adapt tone for different audiences
  • Digital Asset Management: Organize and maintain digital asset libraries and communication workflows to ensure easy retrieval and consistent version control
  • Performance Tracking & Reporting: Help track campaign and content performance metrics; compile simple reports to inform future content decisions
  • Collaboration & Team Support: Work with cross-functional teams to gather approvals, share assets, and maintain clear communication across projects
  • Ad-hoc Communications Projects: Take on other communications tasks and short-term projects as assigned to support team priorities

Internship Learning Outcomes

  • Practical Multimedia Experience: Hands-on experience producing multimedia content tailored for a corporate audience
  • Campaign & Event Coordination: How to plan, coordinate, and execute communications campaigns and internal/external events
  • End-to-End Video Workflow: Practical skills across concepting, shooting, editing, captioning, and distributing short-form video
  • Corporate Writing & Storytelling: Best practices for concise, audience-appropriate corporate writing and storytelling
  • Asset & Workflow Management: Techniques for managing digital asset libraries and optimizing team communication workflows.






Your Profile

You are best equipped for the task if you are/have:


  • Education & Background: Currently enrolled in or recently graduated from Communications, Journalism, Marketing, Media Production, or a related field
  • Organizational Strengths: Strong organizational and administrative skills; comfortable managing calendars, deadlines, and multiple priorities
  • Multimedia Skills: Experience creating basic video content and photography; familiarity with simple photo and video editing tools
  • Writing Proficiency: Clear, concise writing and proofreading skills with the ability to adapt tone for different audiences
  • Social Media Savvy: Familiarity with social platforms and best practices for short-form content formats
  • Collaboration Tools: Comfortable using collaboration and productivity tools (e.g., Webex, SharePoint); quick to learn new platforms

title: Internship - Thermal Measurement & 3D Modeling
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together!

Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

Gain hands-on engineering experience through a 1 year internship in thermal measurement, mechanical testing, and 3D modeling of power modules. Work with 3D modeling tools such as Inventor or SolidWorks while gaining practical exposure to engineering laboratory activities.


  • Thermal measurement: Measure thermal characteristics of power modules

  • Mechanical testing: Perform mechanical tests such as mounting torque

  • 3D drawing: Use 3D modeling tools for module design and drawing


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Undergraduate student majoring in Mechanical Engineering, Mechanical Design Engineering, or a related field

  • Technical skills: Capable of 3D modeling (Inventor or Solidworks)

  • Language skills: Intermediate level of English (written and spoken)

  • Laboratory experience (Preferred): Prior experience working in engineering laboratories

title: Internship - Tax
description_html:
Under the guidance of an assigned mentor, the student would gain exposure to the works of the tax team in areas of tax accounting, corporate tax return filings, good and service tax return filings, transfer pricing report, and tax control framework. The student would also undertake projects on workflow automation and process improvement.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Tax Data Preparation: Verify, extract and analyse information for the preparation of tax work schedules.
  • GST & Tax Return Filing: Render support in filing quarterly GST returns and annual corporate income tax return to IRAS.
  • GST Compliance Checks: Assist in performing GST health checks and ensure that the company is GST compliant.
  • Transfer Pricing Support: Render support in preparing transfer pricing report for the company and its related entities.
  • Auditor Collaboration: Prepare relevant tax and/or reconciliation schedules for auditors.
  • Process Improvement Projects: Undertake projects on workflow automation and process improvement.
  • Ad-Hoc Support: Render support in ad-hoc duties as needed.


Internship Learning Outcomes

  • Financial Statement Analysis: Application and reinforcement of knowledge in analysis of financial statements for tax purposes.
  • Tax Compliance Understanding: Understand the process of corporate tax, GST and/or transfer pricing compliance.
  • Workflow Automation Exposure: Gain exposure to workflow automation and process improvement projects using relevant tools (e.g., KNIME, Tableau, etc.).
  • SAP System Experience: Gain hands-on experience of SAP accounting software.
  • Soft Skills Development: Enhance soft skills such as communication, presentation and time management skills.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Enhance interpersonal relations across departments and management of situation in team settings through problem solving follow-up and resolution of issues.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Educational Background: On track to attaining Diploma / Bachelor / Masters in Accountancy and/or Finance.
  • Personal Attributes: Positive work attitude and willingness to learn.
  • Communication Skills: Effective communication skills.
  • Technical Bonus: Knowledge in SAP / data analytics software is an advantage.
  • Availability Commitment: Able to commit for 5–6 months.
  • Preferred Intake Periods: September 26 – March 26 intake (Diploma) & January 27 – June 27 intake (Bachelor's/Master's).



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

title: Internship - Automotive Radar Validation
description_html:

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together!

Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role

(1 year Internship)


  • Radar validation: Take part in validating advanced automotive ADAS radar systems

  • RF testing: Support radar RF tests and learn to operate specialized equipment

  • Data processing: Use MATLAB to collect radar data and apply signal processing for meaningful insights

  • Verification and validation: Participate in various radar tests to ensure system reliability


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Undergraduate student majoring in Engineering, preferably Electrical or Electronic

  • Technical skills: Comfortable working with MATLAB and interested in signal processing

  • Language skills: Intermediate proficiency in English (written and spoken)

  • Team skills: Eager to collaborate, learn from engineers, and grow in a technical environment

  • Preferred experience: Hands-on experience from electrical or electronic engineering labs, internships, or related institutions

title: Internship - Regional Distribution Centre Logistics Management
description_html:
The student as part of Regional Distribution Centre Team will be working with various stakeholders including our outsourced 3PL warehouse team to facilitate daily operations, covering full set of warehouse activities and monitoring via Infineon Systems (i.e. ERP SAP, Assist4, PIO SAP). The student will also have a chance to involve in projects that are related to digitalization.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Customer Focus: Support continuous improvement initiatives to address customer concerns and enhance overall service quality
  • Operational Excellence: Identify, evaluate, and implement improvements in daily logistics operations to drive efficiency, productivity, and operational effectiveness
  • Focus on the Future: Contribute to logistics and warehouse digitalization projects, including process automation, system integration, and data-driven solutions
  • Take Responsibility: Support day-to-day warehouse and logistics activities while ensuring the accuracy and timely delivery of operational performance reports

    Internship Learning Outcomes:
  • Holistic Overview: Gain a comprehensive understanding of Infineon’s end-to-end Supply Chain operations and logistics warehouse management processes
  • Experience Project Management: Acquire hands-on experience in digital transformation initiatives and emerging technologies within the logistics environment
  • Broaden Your Horizons: Develop insights into the diverse business environments, customer requirements, and market dynamics across Asia Pacific and Europe
  • Stakeholder Management: Strengthen communication and collaboration skills through interactions with internal and external stakeholders across multiple functions and regions
  • Lifelong Learning: Build practical knowledge and operational expertise in SAP and related supply chain systems

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Study Field: Be currently pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Logistics, Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, or a related discipline
  • Interests: Demonstrate a strong interest in supply chain operations, logistics processes, and digital transformation initiatives
  • Personality: Bring a proactive mindset, strong learning agility, self-motivation, and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment
  • Work Style: Apply a structured, analytical, and detail-oriented approach while managing multiple priorities and maintaining strong interpersonal relationships
  • Skills: Possess exposure to SAP, Python, Tableau, or other programming and data analytics tools; experience with these technologies is an added advantage
  • Availability: Be available for an internship starting from May 2027 onward for a duration of 6 to 12 months
  • Language Skills: Demonstrate excellent written and spoken English communication skills

title: Internship - Package Concept Team
description_html:
The student, gets to work with our global team on package design and selection process. He/she will work to analyse and make digitalisation of the package assembly database. Student will also spearhead the platform to enable good selection of package for efficient customer design acceptance and build an application for package information and analysis.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Package Requirements Understanding: Understand the criteria in a package, electrically, structurally, quality standard governing the application.
  • Data Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of large and complex datasets to extract meaningful package concept in technology & assembly for decision-making.
  • Data Collection & Organization: Collect, clean, and organize data from various sources for analysis.
  • Dashboard Development: Work on a dashboard for package selection.
  • App Development: Build a handphone app for package info retrieval.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Advanced Packaging Concepts: Concept and design of advanced packaging in specific automotive solutions.
  • End-to-End Product Exposure: Experience the fast pace and dynamic conceptualisation of a package from design to ramp up phase.
  • Global Team Collaboration: Exposure to various expert team and the team work to realise a final product in a global setting.
  • Career Preparation: Integrate into new package design and launch in the competitive packaging assembly environment.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Bachelor's/ Masters' pursuing engineering studies.
  • Semiconductor Fundamentals: Basic technical understanding of semiconductor material / process / technology.
  • Analytical Capability: Experience with complex dataset, with good analytical mindset.
  • Digital/Programming Exposure: Academic exposure in AI, digitalisation or programming languages (preferred).
  • Initiative & Adaptability: Able to handle changes, take initiative to make solution proposal.
  • Self-Management: Self motivated, highly organised, able to manage task independently.
  • Preferred Intake: Jan 27 – May/June 27.



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

title: University Partnerships and Product Localization Lead
description_html:
Shape the future of semiconductor talent in India!
Join Infineon as a University Partnerships & Product Localisation Lead and build strategic collaborations with leading universities, drive curriculum integration, and enable the next generation of engineers through cutting-edge semiconductor technologies.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Strategic Partnership Development Identify and establish strategic partnerships with top-tier engineering colleges, technical universities, and research institutions across India.
  •  Develop and execute engagement plans including curriculum integration, research collaborations, and faculty development programs.
  •  Facilitate joint initiatives such as semiconductor labs, innovation hubs, sponsored projects and talent acquisition.
  •  Product Localization & Enablement Collaborate with product and engineering teams to localize semiconductor tools, design kits, and training materials for academic use.
  •  Customize technical content, tutorials, and lab modules to align with Indian university curricula and student learning outcomes.
  •  Drive adoption of company products in the university programs. Introducing Infineon products and solutions as well as relevant trainings into the curriculum.
  •  Internal Stakeholder Collaboration Act as a liaison between academic partners and internal teams including Technical Marketing, CAE, Academy, other enablement functions to ensure smooth execution of partnership programs.
  •  Provide insights from academic engagements to inform product development and G2M strategies. 
  • Coordinate with global education and ecosystem teams to align local initiatives with global objectives.
  •  Program Management & Outreach Launch and manage technical workshops, certification courses, hackathons, academic competitions, and curriculum integration initiatives.
  •  Track and report on partnership KPIs, lecturer/student engagement, and product usage metrics.
  •  Advocacy & Thought Leadership Represent the company at academic conferences, technical symposiums, and industry-academia forums.
  •  Advocate for the use of company products in academic settings through presentations, case studies, and success stories.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, or related field.
  •  5+ years of experience in university relations, technical partnerships, or product enablement roles in the semiconductor or EDA industry.
  •  Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and program execution skills.
  •  Preferred Skills: Experience working with academic institutions in India. Familiarity with SoC development, or embedded systems.
  •  Ability to translate complex technical concepts into educational content. Passion for talent development and ecosystem building in the semiconductor space.

Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

  • Coordinate with global education and ecosystem teams to align local initiatives with global objectives.
  •  Program Management & Outreach Launch and manage technical workshops, certification courses, hackathons, academic competitions, and curriculum integration initiatives.
  •  Track and report on partnership KPIs, lecturer/student engagement, and product usage metrics.
  •  Advocacy & Thought Leadership Represent the company at academic conferences, technical symposiums, and industry-academia forums.
  •  Advocate for the use of company products in academic settings through presentations, case studies, and success stories.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Qualifications: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Technology, or related field.
  •  5+ years of experience in university relations, technical partnerships, or product enablement roles in the semiconductor or EDA industry.
  •  Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and program execution skills.
  •  Preferred Skills: Experience working with academic institutions in India. Familiarity with SoC development, or embedded systems.
  •  Ability to translate complex technical concepts into educational content. Passion for talent development and ecosystem building in the semiconductor space.

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Internship - Digitalization, Development Processes & Product Lifecycle Management (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Digital Process Optimization: You develop solutions for the digitalization and automation of workflows
  • Product Lifecycle Management (PLM): You support the further development of workflows and data structures for semiconductor products within the Infineon Product Lifecycle Management system
  • Configuration and Change Management: You support configuration and change management for process development, for example by documenting and tracking changes and develop digital solutions with a focus on automation
  • Teamwork & Agile Collaboration: You regularly develop and test solution approaches together with your colleagues and work in an international team on the digital transformation of our product development
Further Information
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 6 months

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: You are currently enrolled in a degree program in Business Information Systems, Business Engineering, Engineering, Automation Engineering or a comparable field of study
  • Interest & Experience:
    • Strong interest in digitalization, development processes, and/or Product Lifecycle Management
    • Practical programming experience with Python (e.g., for scripting, data analysis)
    • Initial experience in data analysis (e.g., with Python, Excel, or similar tools) 
    • Affinity for software tools and process optimization
  • Skills & Working Style:
    • Good technical understanding and a structured, independent working style
    • High motivation to take a holistic view of topics—from the initial idea through implementation to successful introduction within the team
    • Excellent communication and teamwork skills
    • Willingness to familiarize yourself with new tools and systems
    • Language Skills: Very good English and German skills 
This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

• CV
• Certificate of matriculation at a university
• Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)
• Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students, Bachelor certificate for Master students)
• Reference letter (optional)
• Motivation letter (optional)



Contact:

description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • Configuration and Change Management: Assist in maintaining product configurations, baselines, and configuration records to ensure project data remains accurate and up to date
  • Requirements Management: Support the documentation, organization, and traceability of requirements throughout the development process
  • Documentation and Quality Compliance: Review and maintain project documents while ensuring compliance with internal procedures and relevant quality standards
  • Tool Administration and User Support: Provide support for engineering tools such as Windchill, JIRA, and JAMA, helping users with basic tool-related activities
  • Reporting and Project Support: Prepare traceability and coverage reports and support project teams with configuration and documentation-related tasks
  • Process Improvement and Automation: Identify opportunities to improve efficiency and assist in developing simple scripts or automation solutions for routine activities

Further Information
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 18 months



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related technical field
  • Interpersonal Skills: Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Attention to Detail: Structured and detail-oriented working style with a focus on accuracy and quality
  • Teamwork: Ability to collaborate effectively and work independently
  • Technical Skills: Basic understanding of semiconductor development, knowledge of automotive development processes, ISO 26262, or requirements and configuration management is a plus, familiarity with engineering and project management tools such as JIRA, JAMA, or SVN is an advantage, basic programming or scripting skills (e.g., Python or similar) are beneficial and support process automation activities
  • Language Skills: Fluent in English, German language skills are considered a plus

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

title: Internship - AI-driven Solution for Product Engineering Work Packages
description_html:
The student, as part of the PTE PDE team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will undertake AI-driven projects working on various work packages to streamline operations, enhance productivity and improve process efficiency.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Operations & Automation Support: Assist unit process engineers in daily Final Test operations and automated manufacturing projects.
  • Risk & Incident Management: Support deviation management, crisis resolution, risk assessments, and mitigation planning.
  • Change Management: Assist in coordinating and executing engineering change management projects.
  • Quality & Process Documentation: Develop and update critical engineering documentation, including Process Flows, FMEA, SOPs, OCAPs, and Control Plans.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Backend Test Operations: Gain deep insights into the daily operational workflows within a Semiconductor Backend Test facility.
  • Statistical Quality Control: Understand the application of Statistical Process Control (SPC) and structured deviation management in manufacturing.
  • Production Data Analytics: Learn how to analyze large production datasets and represent engineering data statistically to drive decision-making.
  • Advanced Manufacturing Automation: Acquire hands-on exposure to deploying automation solutions within an industry-leading smart factory.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Educational Foundation: On track to attain a Bachelor's degree in Automation, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.
  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills: A self-driven individual possessing strong analytical capabilities and a structured approach to solving complex problems.
  • Collaboration & Coordination: Highly interpersonal, with a passion for working with cross-functional teams and coordinating project tasks.
  • Technical Tools Advantage: Prior exposure to Tableau, UiPath, or Python is a strong plus.
  • Preferred intake: Jan 27 - May/ June 27

title: Internship - Full Stack Developer
description_html:
The student, as part of the IT R&D lab management solutions team will be contributing to the development of the mobile native application using Outsystems.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Solution Ramp-Up: Ramp-up on the R&D Lab management solutions/use cases identified to be enabled on the mobile native application.
  • Mobile App Development Collaboration: Collaborate with the mobile native application development team and ramp-up on OutSystems by taking available trainings and gradually contributing to the development.
  • Agile Sprint Participation: Be involved in backlog grooming, sprint planning, and demo of implemented features.
  • Agile Development Exposure: Work in an Agile development environment, with real-time experience in release management.

    Internship Learning Outcomes:
  • R&D Lab Operations Understanding: Understand the R&D lab setup, processes, and how they operate within an enterprise environment.
  • OutSystems & Mobile Development: Gain hands-on experience with expert guidance towards the development of the mobile native solution using OutSystems.
  • Full SDLC Exposure: Experience a complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC) following Agile practices, from planning to deployment.
  • Technical Skill Development: Foster deep dive development exposure, testing processes, and technical documentation skills.
  • Backend & API Fundamentals: Strengthen understanding of backend development concepts, API integration, and database management in a real project setting.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s/Master’s degree, or recently graduated, in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Experience: Minimum 2 years of hands-on IT/software development experience (e.g., internships, co-ops, or full-time).
  • Mobile Fundamentals: Basic understanding of mobile application development principles, lifecycle, and common best practices.
  • Backend Foundations: Solid grasp of backend development fundamentals, including databases, server-side logic, and integration patterns.
  • API & Integration: Familiar with REST API concepts and experienced in using Postman for API testing and troubleshooting.
  • Low-Code Interest: Strong interest in learning low-code/mobile development technologies, especially OutSystems.
  • Communication & Teamwork: Strong communication skills with a collaborative, cross-functional working style.
  • Problem Solving: Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and root-cause investigation skills.
  • Agile Ways of Working: Familiarity with Agile methodologies (e.g., Scrum/Kanban) and working in sprint-based delivery.

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Lau Yu Qin

title: Internship - Digital Marketing & Marcom
description_html:
The student, as part of the Digital Marketing and Marcom team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will undertake projects working on Infineon's automotive digital campaign and marcom activities.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Campaign Planning: Assist in planning and strategizing Digital Marketing campaigns.
  • Campaign Launch Execution: Be actively involved in launching and rolling out Digital Campaigns.
  • Performance Monitoring: Monitor and track the real-time performance of Digital Campaigns.
  • Reporting & Analysis: Create digital activity reports and analyze campaign success metrics for optimization.
  • Marcom Support: Support broader marketing communications (marcom) activities to ensure brand consistency and message alignment.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Industry Context: Understand digital marketing objectives and outcomes within the semiconductor industry.
  • B2B Campaign Execution: Learn how to launch and execute digital campaigns and events tailored to the B2B sector.
  • Product Knowledge: Gain foundational understanding of semiconductor products and their market positioning.
  • Cross-Cultural Collaboration: Enhance interpersonal and communication skills while working with diverse teams across countries and cultures.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: On track to attain a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Media, Communication, or Business.
  • Interest Area: Demonstrated interest in Digital Marketing and Marketing Communications (Marcom).
  • Communication Skills: Strong verbal and written communication skills, plus strong interpersonal abilities.
  • Personal Attributes: Creative, enthusiastic, and naturally friendly with a positive, proactive outlook.



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

title: Internship - Application Engineering
description_html:
The student, as part of the Application Engineering team and under the guidance of an assigned supervisor, will undertake projects working on system hardware/firmware/software solutions development activities related to various use cases with security products.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Software Development: Assist engineers in system project code development, testing, and verification of microcontroller system and security products.
  • Testing and Validation: Build evaluation kits and perform system function verification and testing.
  • Documentation: Prepare application notes and getting-started guides for various solutions developed.
  • Programming: Assist in coding in C/C++, Python, and shell scripts for Linux/Windows environments.
  • Version Control: Manage code repositories using GitHub, GitLab, or Bitbucket.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Troubleshooting: Gain knowledge and methodology in system troubleshooting and analysis.
  • Analysis: Learn how to document outcomes of the analysis process.
  • Operating Systems and Security: Acquire programming and system security know-how in Linux/Windows environments.
  • Open Source Collaboration: Collaborate and contribute to open-source development projects.




Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Currently pursuing a Bachelor’s degree in Electrical, Electronic, Computer, or Industrial Engineering.
  • Programming Experience: Prior coding experience in any programming language, with software version control tool knowledge (Git).
  • Embedded Systems: Prior Linux and MCU-based programming experience.
  • Technical Analysis: Exposure to system technical or functional analysis.
  • Documentation Skills: Proficient in Microsoft PowerPoint and document preparation.
  • Problem Solving: Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

description_html:
The student, as part of the Advanced and Visual Analytics (AVA) team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will undertake projects working on Agentic AI and Gen-AI projects.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Agentic AI Development: Design and develop agentic AI applications leveraging Large Language Models (LLMs), multi-agent frameworks, and orchestration platforms.
  • AI Agent Engineering: Build, test, and optimize AI agents capable of autonomous reasoning, planning, tool usage, and task execution.
  • Systems Integration: Integrate AI agents with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and business workflows to enable real-world use cases.
  • Cross-Functional Prototyping: Collaborate with cross-functional teams to prototype innovative AI solutions and validate business value through proof-of-concepts.
  • Technology Evaluation: Evaluate emerging AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices to continuously improve agent performance, reliability, and scalability.
  • Documentation & Knowledge Sharing: Contribute to technical documentation, knowledge sharing, and presentations of developed solutions.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • LLM Application Development: Gain hands-on experience in building applications using LLMs, multi-agent systems, and orchestration platforms.
  • AI Agent Optimization: Develop practical skills in testing, tuning, and improving autonomous AI agents for complex tasks.
  • Enterprise Integration Exposure: Learn how to connect AI solutions with enterprise systems, APIs, databases, and workflows.
  • Proof-of-Concept Development: Strengthen the ability to prototype, validate, and communicate AI solution value in business settings.
  • Emerging AI Knowledge: Gain exposure to current AI technologies, frameworks, and best practices in agentic AI development.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Currently pursuing a degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • Programming Skills: Strong programming foundations, ideally with experience in Python or similar languages.
  • AI/ML Knowledge: Familiarity with LLMs, agent frameworks, or machine learning concepts is an advantage.
  • Problem-Solving Ability: Strong analytical thinking with the ability to design practical and scalable solutions.
  • Collaboration & Communication: Able to work effectively with cross-functional teams and communicate technical ideas clearly.

title: Internship - Integration of AI into Reliability and Qualification Digital Workflow
description_html:
Join our Back-End Reliability and Qualification team and gain hands-on experience in integrating AI into engineering workflows. In this internship, you will explore real-world reliability and qualification processes, identify opportunities for AI adoption, and contribute to developing practical solutions that improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and support systematic implementation across the organization.

Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role 


  • Identify Needs: Map agreed workflows and identify repetitive tasks that are suitable for AI-supported solutions
  • Experience Research: Review existing processes to evaluate use cases that deliver cost advantages, time savings, and effective system implementation
  • Work Reliably: Prepare approved datasets and documents while ensuring data quality, traceability, and compliance with established standards
  • Be Creative: Build and test AI prototypes for selected use cases such as report drafting, information retrieval, or data extraction
  • Strength in Numbers: Compare AI-generated outputs against engineer-reviewed examples and record errors, limitations, and performance metrics
  • Convince Others with Your Words: Document solutions and demonstrate outcomes to users while following data-access requirements and maintaining human review of engineering decisions

    Learning Outcomes:
  • Business Understanding: Explain Back-End Reliability and Qualification workflows and translate user requirements into practical AI use cases
  • Technical Expertise: Develop and connect AI prototypes to approved data sources using traceable datasets
  • Knowledge Development: Apply fundamental AI and language-model techniques and understand their limitations in engineering applications
  • Problem Solving: Evaluate output quality and workflow efficiency against manual baselines using defined test cases
  • Professional Growth: Apply responsible AI practices, including confidentiality requirements and human oversight of generated content
  • Communication Skills: Present a working solution and deliver reusable code together with clear user documentation

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed  



  • Study Field: Be currently enrolled in a degree program in Computing, Data Science, Engineering, or a related discipline
  • Experience: Bring foundational knowledge of AI or machine learning through coursework or student projects
  • Work Style: Demonstrate structured problem-solving skills and a careful approach to validating data and results
  • Personality: Show strong communication skills, effective documentation practices, and eagerness to learn from engineering professionals
  • Skills: Possess basic Python programming skills and experience working with spreadsheet or tabular data; familiarity with language-model prompting, document retrieval, SQL, APIs, Git, or workflow automation tools is an advantage
  • Language Skills: Demonstrate good written and verbal communication skills in English

#WeAreIn for driving decarbonization and digitalization.
As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Lau Yu Qin

title: Bachelor Thesis - Artificial Intelligence in Microcontroller (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?

Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role

  • System Architecture: Define end-to-end system architecture and requirements
  • Data Pipeline Development: Build data pipelines and simulation/benchmark frameworks with suitable metrics
  • Algorithm Development: Develop and train algorithms for event/data-efficient inference
  • Model Optimization: Map and optimize models for edge hardware through techniques like quantization and pruning
  • Real-time Integration: Implement real-time integration of sensing, compute, and comms with robustness features
  • Validation and Benchmarking: Validate prototypes and run power, latency, and accuracy benchmarking across scenarios

This thesis has to be written in cooperation with a university.

Further Information
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 6 months

Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Pursuing a Bachelor's degree (at least in the 5th semester) in a relevant technical field such as Electrical Engineering, Physics, Information Technology, or similar field
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English, with German as a plus
  • Problem-Solving: Ability to recognize problems, evaluate options and take action 
  • Teamwork: Ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary team environment, collaborating with others to achieve common goals

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Please attach the following documents (German or English) to your application:

• CV
• Certificate of matriculation at a university
• Latest Transcript of records (not older than 6 months)
• Highest completed educational certificate (Matura certificate for Bachelor students)
• Reference letter (optional)
• Motivation letter (optional)


Contact:

description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. Are you in?



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Calibration Support: Maintain the equipment list, schedule calibration services, and manage filing of calibration certificates
  • Procurement Management: Set up and handle purchase requests and POs in the ERP system, monitor deliveries and invoices, and ensure availability of consumables and spare parts
  • Lab Logistics: Manage daily lab activities such as bookings, access control, visitor coordination, and shipments
  • Documentation: Maintain organized documentation, including SOPs, work instructions, logs, and records, while preparing reports and audit materials


Further Informaton


Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min. 12 months



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed

  • Education: Enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in afield from the technical disciplines, Economics, Business Administration, Media and Communication or from related areas
  • Communication Skills: Strong organizational skills combined with excellent written and verbal communication abilities
  • Teamwork: Demonstrated ability to work effectively within a collaborative team environment
  • Data Analytics: Proficiency or familiarity with data analysis and reporting tools (e.g., Tableau), along with a keen interest in data-driven decision-making

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

title: Internship: 3rd Party IP Automation using Agentic AI (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Automation: Enhance the provisioning flow and data management for third-party intellectual property (IP) using agentic artificial intelligence (AI)
  • Circuits: Gain exposure to digital and mixed-signal integrated circuits
  • Tools: Work with Computer Aided Design (CAD) tools for design and verification
  • Preparation: Learn state-of-the-art design preparation and provisioning techniques
  • Quality: Verify design data quality through hands-on checks and reviews
  • Processes: Become familiar with the chip development flow and the third-party intellectual property lifecycle at Infineon

Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time or full-time / (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: 12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Enrolled in a degree in Electronic Engineering or Computer Science
  • Teamwork: Willing to collaborate within a highly motivated team. Comfortable working in a multicultural, international environment
  • Language Skills: English: good; German: a plus

Additional information

This position is subject to the collective agreement for workers and employees in the electrical and electronics industry (full-time), employment group B for bachelor students, employment group D for master students (https://www.feei.at/wp-content/uploads/2026/06/minimum-salaries-white-collar-workers-2026-05-01.pdf).

Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.


Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.


Sabrina Nindler

title: Internship - AI and Machine Learning Software Engineering (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.

Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Application Development: Build and maintain Python based desktop tools for engineering
  • Tooling Infrastructure: Create distribution solutions including installers, automatic updates, shared databases, and SharePoint and Microsoft 365 integration
  • Intelligent Features: Implement Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Machine Learning (ML) capabilities including automated data extraction from PDF documents, intelligent analysis and reporting, and AI-assisted engineering workflows
  • Quality Engineering: Strengthen code architecture, testing, packaging, and documentation practices
  • Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with engineers to translate their needs into practical tool features
  • Academic Writing: Possibility to develop a Master's thesis aligned with the internship topics

Further Information:

Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time or Full-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)

Duration: min.12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Currently pursuing a Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Data Science, Artificial Intelligence, or a similar field
  • Programming: Strong Python skills
  • Frameworks: Experience with Graphical User Interface (GUI) applications, data processing, or ML/LLM frameworks is a plus
  • Interests: Interest in engineering applications and in working with non-software experts

description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers. 

The future won’t wait... why should you? Join us and make a difference. Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow. 

Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


In this professional internship opportunity, with a fixed-term contract of 12 months, you will:


  • Administrative Support: Provide support to HR Business Partners with administrative processes within the employee lifecycle; Administer HR-related matters (e.g., working time topics, contract management, reference letters)
  • Process Improvement & Digitalization: Initiate process improvements and support the digitalization of HR processes
  • Requirements Compliance: Ensure compliance with legal requirements and company policies
  • Communication & Collaboration: Share and exchange information with all levels of management; Collaborate closely with HR counterparts across multiple locations

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


You have a proactive personality and good communication skills, willing to actively support and cooperate with your team members. Besides, you are a fast learner, eager to develop your knowledge, and you have a strong customer orientation focus.


  • Education: A degree ideally in Human Resources, Psychology, Languages, or a similar field
  • Tools: Good command of Microsoft Office; Affinity towards digital tools
  • Working Style: You take responsibility and focus on providing a high-quality service to internal customers; You structure your own work within the team and collaborate with all levels of management

title: Internship - Business Development (Robotics)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together!

Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


As a 1 Year Internship - Business Development (Robotics), you will explore how market insights become real business opportunities while gaining exposure to customers, partners, and innovation stakeholders across South Korea. Over 12 months, you will build practical business development skills, take increasing ownership of defined workstreams, and deliver a final market or ecosystem project


  • Market and Customer Research: Research robotics applications, market developments, customer needs, and competitor and partner activities to identify business signals and potential opportunities
  • Ecosystem Engagement: Map companies, public institutions, research organizations, universities, industry associations, technology partners, and system integrators using publicly available information 
  • Opportunity Development: Contribute to prospective customer engagement through prospect lists, company profiles, meeting briefs, and presentation materials 
  • Business Reporting: Maintain customer, opportunity, and stakeholder trackers and prepare activity summaries and simple dashboards 
  • Go-to-Market Support: Help bring local robotics initiatives and events to life through invitee research, presentation preparation, logistics, feedback, and follow-up 
  • Meeting and Project Coordination: Participate in customer and stakeholder activities by organizing agendas, meeting notes, action items, workshops, and follow-up activities 
  • Collaboration and Information Handling: Coordinate cross-functional inputs and handle business information in line with confidentiality and data protection requirements 

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education — Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree or currently pursuing a bachelor’s degree
  • Field of Study — Preferred: Studies in business, economics, engineering, electronics, or a related discipline
  • Language Skills — Mandatory: Professional working proficiency in written and spoken Korean and English, including participation in business discussions
  • Digital Skills — Mandatory: Proficiency in using AI-powered tools
  • Research and Communication — Preferred: Ability to turn online research and complex information into concise briefs and presentation materials
  • Working Behavior — Mandatory: Organized and detail-oriented approach with proactive communication, clear questions, and reliable follow-through across multiple tasks
  • Industry Interest — Nice-to-Have: Interest in robotics, semiconductors, industrial technology, business development, or innovation ecosystems, with related industry experience helpful but not required

As a global leader in semiconductor solutions in power systems and IoT, Infineon enables game-changing solutions for green and efficient energy, clean and safe mobility, as well as smart and secure IoT. Together, we drive innovation and customer success, while caring for our people and empowering them to reach ambitious goals. Be a part of making life easier, safer and greener.
Are you in?

We are on a journey to create the best Infineon for everyone.

We strive to create the best Infineon for everyone by embracing diversity and inclusion. We welcome applicants for who they are and offer a workplace built on trust, openness, respect and equal opportunity. 

Our hiring decisions are based on skills and experience. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply.

Please let your recruiter know if you need any accommodations during the interview process.

Learn more about our various contact channels and about Diversity & Inclusion at Infineon.

title: Internship - Automation Engineering
description_html:
The student, as part of the Operation Automation team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will assist the Automation Engineer to sustain and undertake projects working on Infineon Singapore Advanced factory automation equipment and support upcoming automation projects in Infineon Advance Automation drive.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Automation Operations Support: Assist automation engineers in day-to-day operation support on factory automation equipment (AMR, Robotic, OHT, AMHS, Auto-packing Equipment, etc).
  • Data Digitalization: Assist in the digitalization of equipment operation data for day-to-day performance monitoring.
  • Hardware & Analytics Development: Assist in data analytics, design & development of future hardware to improve existing automation equipment.
  • Advanced Automation Projects: Involve in Advanced Automation projects in integration, testing, performance analysis, system safety and operation run to achieve Advanced Automation.

    Internship Learning Outcomes: 
  • Automation Engineering Experience: Carry out day-to-day tasks of an Automation Engineer, gaining firsthand exposure to factory automation operations and workflows.
  • Hands-On Project Participation: Aid in the performance of assignments required, building practical skills through active involvement in real engineering tasks.
  • Advanced Factory Exposure: Gain a greater overview of automation projects in the operation of an Advanced Factory environment.
  • Industry 4.0 Understanding: Understand the next level of manufacturing to achieve Industry 4.0, including smart systems, connected equipment, and data-driven operations.
  • Digital & Analytical Skills: Develop competencies in data digitalization, equipment performance monitoring, and analytics tools used in modern manufacturing.

title: Internship - Logistics Analyst
description_html:
The student will be working with various stakeholders on the various projects involving digitalization and decarbonization.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Logistics Support: Provide support across all logistics sub-teams, including Warehouse Management, Transit Management, Quality Management, Engineering, and Analytics.
  • Digitalization & Decarbonization: Support and contribute to Logistics Digitalization and Decarbonization initiatives.
  • Cross-Functional Support: Assist logistics sub-teams with day-to-day operational and project-related tasks.
  • Coordination & Scheduling: Coordinate and schedule meetings, appointments, and events as required.
  • Research & Analysis: Conduct research and gather information to support project activities and tasks.
  • Project Support: Perform additional tasks and responsibilities assigned by the project team.
  • Visualization Development: Support the development of a visualization dashboard as a project manager or developer.
  • Documentation & Training: Assist in preparing logistics process documentation, Confluence pages, and training materials.

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Supply Chain Knowledge: Gain an understanding of Infineon’s Global Supply Chain and Logistics processes.
  • Digitalization Exposure: Build hands-on exposure to digitalization projects and initiatives.
  • Project Management Skills: Develop project management skills through active project contributions.
  • Business Understanding: Learn about business environments across Asia Pacific and Europe.
  • Stakeholder Communication: Enhance communication and collaboration skills with various stakeholders.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: Currently pursuing a degree in IT, Computer Science, Digital Supply Chain, or Engineering.
  • Technical Skills: Academic exposure to Python, SQL, and Tableau.
  • Organizational Skills: Excellent organizational and time management abilities.
  • Attention to Detail: Strong attention to detail with the ability to work accurately.
  • Teamwork & Independence: Ability to work independently as well as collaboratively within a team.
  • Analytical Skills: Strong analytical capabilities with a passion for analytics dashboards.
  • Availability: Available for 6-month (Jan 27 - June 27) to 1-year internship opportunity (Jan 27 - Dec 27).



Contact:

title: Internship - Strategy M&A Infineon Asia Pacific
description_html:
As an integral part of Infineon’s global corporate strategy, we at the Strategy and Market Development team are keenly focused on the fast-paced Asian markets, and are actively developing Infineon’s presence in the key growth markets. We are looking for dynamic and highly motivated interns to support our market / business intelligence research and strategy development activities.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Undertake responsibilities that involve a blend of desk and field research
  • Collect, clean and analyze quantitative data to develop critical insights and pragmatic data solutions and you'll source, scrub and join relevant public, commercial, and proprietary data sources
  • Apply your deep technical knowledge of machine learning to identify insights and patterns using traditional as well as predictive and prescriptive analytics
  • Design and create advanced predictive models such as support vector machines, neural networks, decision trees, etc., to allow more informed business decision


Internship Learning Outcomes

  • The internship provides an unique opportunity to gain deep insights into the strategy function of a DAX-30 multinational company, with specific learning related to the various Asia Pacific market segments for semiconductors and electronics.
  • By the end of the internship, candidates will have worked on a variety of projects, gaining hands-on experience in several areas: Project management, working with team members across various locations and functions
  • Exposure to business intelligence research and data gathering through online and offline sources, including desk research and interactions with various stakeholders
  • Exposure to Data analysis and correlation with operational and strategic business outcomes



Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Bachelor’s / Master’s degree student in Business Administration, IT / Computer Science & Computer Engineering, Economics, Electrical & Electronic Engineering, Industrial Engineering 
  • Proficiency in MS Excel and MS PowerPoint Strong analytical skills
  • Able to work independently and proactively
  • Able to commit for 6 months. Candidates with shorter availability period are welcome to apply



Contact:

title: Internship - Software Developer for Test Engineering (f/m/div)
description_html:
#WeAreIn to create tiny chips and big careers.
Are you ready to take the first step in your career? Let's shape the future together! Whether you join as a student, intern, or trainee, you'll be part of something real - real projects, real impact, and real opportunities to grow.
Are you in?


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Automation: Build scripts and software solutions to automate test and measurement procedures
  • Migration: Convert existing macros to Python
  • Optimization: Prioritize solutions that improve the speed, quality, and reliability of measurement processes
  • Collaboration: Work closely with the team to ensure solutions meet specific requirements
  • Documentation: Create usage instructions and maintain documentation for developed scripts and test systems

Further Information:
Type of employment: Temporary / Part-time (flexible working hours from Monday to Friday between 6 a.m. and 7 p.m.)
Duration: min.12 months


Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Enrolled in a degree in Electronics, Electrical Engineering, Informatics or a related field 
  • Programming: Solid knowledge of Python, C++ or similar languages
  • Electronics: Basic understanding of electronics or electrical engineering is a plus
  • Soft Skills: Teamwork, good communication, and problem solving abilities
  • Language Skills: Fluency in English, German is an advantage

title: Internship - Master Data Analyst
description_html:
The student, as part of the Master Data team will assist the HoD / Digitalisation Team Lead in running departmental digitalisation transformation projects, including but not limited to the implementation of AI agents for supply chain & analytical use cases, data centralisation development as well as research-based work.



Your Role

Key responsibilities in your new role


  • AI Agent Development: Prototype an AI agent to analyze supply chain datasets, detect anomalies and data quality issues, and support root-cause analysis and resolution workflows under mentorship from senior engineers.
  • Data Virtualization & Integration: Create unified data views through virtualized or semantic layers that centralize data objects from multiple enterprise systems and databases into a single governed source for consistent, self-service analytics.
  • Rule-Based Management Support: Assist the project lead in implementing Rule Based Management Systems in Infineon’s Global Master Data applications by defining maintenance processes, validation and derivation rules, and approval workflows while validating results and tracking issues in Jira/Octane.
  • Data Analysis & Profiling: Conduct supply chain and Product Master Data analysis using SQL, Python (Pandas), and Excel to assess data completeness, consistency, uniqueness, and accuracy, and produce profiling reports highlighting issues such as missing attributes, duplicate products, and inconsistent routes.
  • Digital Transformation Support: Contribute to internal communications and engagement activities related to departmental digital transformation initiatives as part of the project office.
  • Data Governance & Quality Management: Ensure ongoing data quality and governance by defining executable data quality rules, monitoring KPIs through Tableau dashboards, and maintaining documentation and change logs in

Internship Learning Outcomes:

  • Master Data Knowledge: Understand master data domains and processes (e.g., product, planning, materials) and how they enable business and manufacturing operations.
  • Data Engineering & Visualization: Gain hands-on skills in data profiling, mapping, and transformations; configure and test data in Global Master Data applications; visualize data quality using BI tools such as Tableau, SAP BO, or Denodo.
  • Testing & Governance: Build testing and governance capabilities by writing UAT scripts, performing fit–gap analysis, monitoring data quality KPIs, and maintaining comprehensive documentation.
  • Professional Development: Strengthen analytical, communication, project management, and problem-solving skills through cross-functional collaboration and clear, structured documentation.
  • AI Implementation Experience: Gain practical experience in deploying AI agents for real-world supply chain use cases.
  • Global Project Exposure: Participate in global initiatives within a leading semiconductor company, gaining insight into international operations and best practices.


Your Profile

Qualifications and skills to help you succeed


  • Education: On track to attain a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Analytics, Engineering, or a relevant field.
  • Preferred Technical Skills: Familiarity with Python, Generative AI (GenAI), Tableau, SAP BO, Denodo; HTML knowledge is a plus.
  • Preferred Intake: January 27 - May/ June 27



Contact:


    Lau Yu Qin

title: Internship - Data Analysis & Reporting
description_html:
The student will as part of the Data analytics and Reporting team support in further enhancing the reporting needs of the BE OSAT Procurement team. E.g. support the creation of our cost model database including Design for Sourcing portal.


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Requirements Gathering: Identify reporting needs through user interviews.
  • Dashboard Development: Build data dashboards from scratch.
  • Data Structuring & Standardization: Organize data in a structured way so it can be consistently used for reporting.
  • Deployment & User Enablement: Deploy new dashboards to users and provide basic support to ensure adoption.  
  • Database Coding Support: Support coding activities for different databases (e.g., queries, data extraction, integration).

    Internship Learning Outcomes:
  • Procurement Fundamentals: Develop an understanding of procurement main activities.  
  • OSAT Business Context: Gain understanding of the OSAT business environment and how procurement supports operations.
  • Data Storytelling for Procurement: Learn the data needs of OSAT procurement professionals and best practices to present data effectively for decision-making.  
  • Cost Modeling Exposure: Assist in building a should-cost model to estimate fair manufacturing costs based on raw material cost, market rates, and logical calculation methodologies.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Domain Interest: Background and/or strong interest in data science and data analytics.
  • Technical Advantage: Bonus if you have coding capabilities and enjoy working with people to deliver solutions to their challenges.
  • Learning Mindset: Receptive mindset with willingness to acquire new competencies quickly.
  • Analytical Curiosity: Intellectual curiosity and desire to understand complex problems and propose meaningful
  • Preferred intake: Able to commit to 5 months or longer internship

title: Internship - AI-assisted Test & Measurement Automation
description_html:
The student, as part of the Electrical Failure Analysis (EFA) team and under the guidance of an assigned mentor, will undertake projects working on Infineon's flagship TriCore-based Automotive Micro-controllers. 


Your role
Key responsibilities in your new role


  • Bench Measurement Automation: Automate bench measurements using software and AI tools.
  • Lab Instrument Integration: Work with engineers to connect lab instruments, collect and analyze measurement data, and develop workflows that make testing faster and more repeatable.
  • Model Evaluation & Validation: Evaluate and validate models and document the result, risk and limitations.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and drive knowledge sharing through documentation and demos.

    Internship Learning Outcomes:
  • Team & Domain Context: Understand the set-up of the EFA team in the semiconductor company.
  • Measurement Fundamentals: Gain hands-on proficiency with bench instruments (oscilloscopes, DMMs, power supplies, analyzers, probes) and measurement fundamentals such as accuracy, resolution, calibration, and uncertainty.
  • Automated Data Acquisition: Build automated data acquisition pipelines — logging, structuring, and storing measurement data.
  • AI in Measurement Context: Understand the limitations and validation requirements of AI in a measurement context (correlating automated vs. manual results).
  • Failure Analysis Exposure: Understand the failure analysis / device characterization workflow.

Your profile
Qualifications and skills to help you succeed 


  • Education: Electrical engineering, computer engineering or computer science.
  • ML/DL Fundamentals: Solid foundation in machine learning/deep learning fundamentals.
  • GenAI & Agentic AI Knowledge: Understanding of GenAI/LLMs (prompt engineering, embeddings, RAG) and related tooling; basic agentic AI concepts.
  • Electronics Background: Understanding of basic circuit components and ability to read and interpret circuit diagrams.
  • Learning Mindset & Collaboration: Strong learning mindset and ownership: proactive, detail-oriented, able to communicate clearly and collaborate across teams.
